````text
11: bool World::checkCollision(const glm::vec2& posA, const glm::vec2& sizeA,
12:                            const glm::vec2& posB, const glm::vec2& sizeB) const {
13:     float halfAx = sizeA.x * 0.5f;
14:     float halfAy = sizeA.y * 0.5f;
15:     float halfBx = sizeB.x * 0.5f;
16:     float halfBy = sizeB.y * 0.5f;
17: 
18:     bool overlapX = (posA.x + halfAx >= posB.x - halfBx) && (posA.x - halfAx <= posB.x + halfBx);
19:     bool overlapY = (posA.y + halfAy >= posB.y - halfBy) && (posA.y - halfAy <= posB.y + halfBy);
20: 
21:     return overlapX && overlapY;
22: }

24: bool World::hasSolidGroundAt(float x, float y, float toleranceY) const {
25:     for (const auto& tile : tiles) {
26:         if (tile.isLadder) continue;
27:         float halfW = tile.size.x * 0.5f;
28:         float halfH = tile.size.y * 0.5f;
29:         if (x >= tile.pos.x - halfW && x <= tile.pos.x + halfW) {
30:             float tileTop = tile.pos.y + halfH;
31:             if (std::abs(tileTop - y) <= toleranceY) {
32:                 return true;
33:             }
34:         }
35:     }
36:     if (std::abs((BEDROCK_Y + 0.5f) - y) <= toleranceY) {
37:         return true;
38:     }
39:     return false;
40: }

42: void World::generateChunk(float startX, float endX, bool isInitial, EnvironmentTheme theme) {
43:     const float TILE_SIZE = 1.0f;
44: 
45:     // List of planned open chasms (e.g. for downward slopes to underground) so platforms never block them!
46:     struct ChasmSpan {
47:         float x1, x2;
48:     };
49:     std::vector<ChasmSpan> chasmSpans;
50: 
51:     // Plan steep slopes leading underground in advance so we carve out the surface ground!
52:     if (!isInitial) {
53:         float testX = startX + 4.0f;
54:         while (testX < endX - 6.0f) {
55:             if (std::rand() % 3 == 0) {
56:                 float sX = testX;
57:                 float eX = sX + 4.8f;
58:                 chasmSpans.push_back({sX - 0.6f, eX + 0.6f});
59: 
60:                 SteepSlope caveSlope;
61:                 caveSlope.startX = sX;
62:                 caveSlope.endX   = eX;
63:                 caveSlope.startY = SURFACE_GROUND_Y + 0.5f; // Start flush with surface ground
64:                 caveSlope.endY   = CAVERN_FLOOR_Y + 0.5f;   // End flush with cavern floor
65:                 caveSlope.angle  = std::atan2(caveSlope.endY - caveSlope.startY, caveSlope.endX - caveSlope.startX);
66:                 caveSlope.theme  = theme;
67:                 slopes.push_back(caveSlope);
68: 
69:                 testX += 12.0f;
70:             } else {
71:                 testX += 8.0f;
72:             }
73:         }
74:     }
75: 
76:     auto isInsideChasm = [&](float x) {
77:         for (const auto& span : chasmSpans) {
78:             if (x >= span.x1 && x <= span.x2) return true;
79:         }
80:         return false;
81:     };
82: 
83:     // Pre-plan underground ladder shafts so surface ground has one-way entrance and no blocking dirt
84:     std::vector<float> undergroundShaftXs;
85:     if (isInitial) {
86:         undergroundShaftXs = { -12.0f, 11.0f };
87:     } else {
88:         float curX = startX + 2.0f;
89:         while (curX < endX - 4.0f) {
90:             if (!isInsideChasm(curX) && std::rand() % 2 == 0) {
91:                 undergroundShaftXs.push_back(curX + 1.5f);
92:             }
93:             curX += 8.0f;
94:         }
95:     }
96: 
97:     auto isUndergroundShaft = [&](float x) {
98:         for (float sx : undergroundShaftXs) {
99:             if (std::abs(x - sx) < 0.85f) return true;
100:         }
101:         return false;
102:     };
103: 
104:     // 1. Bedrock Safety Foundation (Zero out-of-bounds fall deaths!)
105:     for (float x = startX; x < endX; x += TILE_SIZE) {
106:         bool hasSpike = (!isInitial && (std::rand() % 16 == 0));
107:         if (hasSpike) {
108:             SpikeTrap spike;
109:             spike.pos = glm::vec2(x + TILE_SIZE * 0.5f, BEDROCK_Y + 0.62f);
110:             spike.size = glm::vec2(0.85f, 0.7f);
111:             spikes.push_back(spike);
112:         }
113: 
114:         PlatformTile bedrockTop;
115:         bedrockTop.pos = glm::vec2(x + TILE_SIZE * 0.5f, BEDROCK_Y);
116:         bedrockTop.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
117:         bedrockTop.tileX = 1; bedrockTop.tileY = 2; // Deep rock
118:         bedrockTop.isLadder = false; bedrockTop.isOneWay = false; bedrockTop.theme = theme;
119:         tiles.push_back(bedrockTop);
120:     }
121: 
122:     // 2. Surface Ground Level (Y = SURFACE_GROUND_Y = -0.5f)
123:     // NOTE: Surface ground tiles are explicitly OMITTED over any chasm/slope span so the underground path is NEVER blocked!
124:     for (float x = startX; x < endX; x += TILE_SIZE) {
125:         float midTileX = x + TILE_SIZE * 0.5f;
126:         if (isInsideChasm(midTileX)) {
127:             continue; // Completely open chasm for downward slope / cavern entry!
128:         }
129: 
130:         bool isShaft = isUndergroundShaft(midTileX);
131: 
132:         PlatformTile sTop;
133:         sTop.pos = glm::vec2(midTileX, SURFACE_GROUND_Y);
134:         sTop.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
135:         sTop.tileX = 1; sTop.tileY = 0; // Surface grass
136:         sTop.isLadder = false;
137:         sTop.isOneWay = isShaft; // One-way hatch at top of ladder shaft so player can press DOWN to descend!
138:         sTop.theme = theme;
139:         tiles.push_back(sTop);
140: 
141:         // Omit solid dirt block if there is a vertical ladder shaft passing through!
142:         if (!isShaft) {
143:             PlatformTile sDirt;
144:             sDirt.pos = glm::vec2(midTileX, SURFACE_GROUND_Y - TILE_SIZE);
145:             sDirt.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
146:             sDirt.tileX = 1; sDirt.tileY = 1;
147:             sDirt.isLadder = false; sDirt.isOneWay = false; sDirt.theme = theme;
148:             tiles.push_back(sDirt);
149:         }
150:     }
151: 
152:     // 3. Underground Cavern Floor (Y = CAVERN_FLOOR_Y = -4.5f)
153:     for (float x = startX; x < endX; x += TILE_SIZE) {
154:         PlatformTile cTop;
155:         cTop.pos = glm::vec2(x + TILE_SIZE * 0.5f, CAVERN_FLOOR_Y);
156:         cTop.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
157:         cTop.tileX = 1; cTop.tileY = 1; // Subterranean stone/dirt floor
158:         cTop.isLadder = false; cTop.isOneWay = false; cTop.theme = theme;
159:         tiles.push_back(cTop);
160: 
161:         if (!isInitial && (std::rand() % 16 == 0)) {
162:             SpikeTrap spike;
163:             spike.pos = glm::vec2(x + TILE_SIZE * 0.5f, CAVERN_FLOOR_Y + 0.62f);
164:             spike.size = glm::vec2(0.85f, 0.7f);
165:             spikes.push_back(spike);
166:         }
167:     }
168: 
169:     if (isInitial) {
170:         // Generate structured starting platforms on both the left side (-24 to -2) and right side (4 to 30)
171:         auto spawnPlatform = [&](float px, float py, int length, bool withLadder, bool withRelic) {
172:             for (int i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
173:                 PlatformTile plat;
174:                 plat.pos = glm::vec2(px + (i + 0.5f) * TILE_SIZE, py);
175:                 plat.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
176:                 plat.tileX = (i == 0) ? 0 : (i == length - 1) ? 2 : 1;
177:                 plat.tileY = 0;
178:                 plat.isLadder = false;
179:                 plat.isOneWay = true;
180:                 plat.theme = theme;
181:                 tiles.push_back(plat);
182: 
183:                 if (i % 2 == 1) {
184:                     AnimatedCoin coin;
185:                     coin.pos = glm::vec2(plat.pos.x, py + 0.9f);
186:                     coin.animTimer = static_cast<float>(i * 2);
187:                     coin.collected = false;
188:                     coins.push_back(coin);
189:                 }
190:             }
191: 
192:             if (withLadder) {
193:                 float shaftX = px + 1.5f;
194:                 float shaftBottom = SURFACE_GROUND_Y;
195:                 float shaftTop = py;
196: 
197:                 LadderTunnel tunnel;
198:                 tunnel.x = shaftX;
199:                 tunnel.minY = shaftBottom;
200:                 tunnel.maxY = shaftTop;
201:                 tunnel.width = 2.4f;
202:                 tunnel.playerInside = false;
203:                 tunnels.push_back(tunnel);
204: 
205:                 for (float ly = shaftBottom; ly <= shaftTop; ly += TILE_SIZE) {
206:                     PlatformTile lad;
207:                     lad.pos = glm::vec2(shaftX, ly);
208:                     lad.size = glm::vec2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE);
209:                     lad.tileX = 9; lad.tileY = (ly >= shaftTop - 0.1f) ? 3 : 4;
210:                     lad.isLadder = true; lad.isOneWay = false; lad.theme = theme;
211:                     tiles.push_back(lad);
212:                 }
213:             }
214: 
215:             if (withRelic) {
````

````text
23:     playerY = 0.0f;
24:     playerX = TRACK_X[1];
25:     isLeaping = false;
26:     leapProgress = 1.0f;
27:     isHit = false;
28:     hitVelY = 0.0f;
29:     darkAlpha = 0.0f;
30:     isResurrectingState = false;
31:     resurrectTimer = 0.0f;
32:     traps.clear();
33:     items.clear();
34:     genTopY = 5.0f;
35:     scenePlayTime = 0.0f;
36:     directionUnlockedNotified = false;
37: 
38:     // Generate initial traps and collectibles across the 3 endless ladders (initial ~25m)
39:     for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
40:         float y = 5.0f + i * 4.2f;
41:         int trapLane = std::rand() % 3;
42:         traps.push_back({ trapLane, y, std::rand() % 2, true });
43: 
44:         int itemLane = (trapLane + 1 + (std::rand() % 2)) % 3;
45:         if (i % 2 == 0) {
46:             items.push_back({ itemLane, y + 1.2f, 1, std::rand() % 4, false }); // Shield pickup
47:         } else {
48:             items.push_back({ itemLane, y + 1.2f, 0, 0, false }); // Coin
49:         }
50:         genTopY = y;
51:     }
52: 
53:     showCornerNotification("SCENE ENTER", "^^^ 3-LADDER ASCENT ^^^", "Survive 15s trial before direction shifts!", glm::vec4(0.35f, 0.95f, 0.4f, 1.0f), 1, 2);
54:     spawnFloatingText("^^^ 3-LADDER TRIAL (15s) ^^^", glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.2f), glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.45f, 1.0f));
55: }
56: 
57: void LadderScene::update(float deltaTime, GLFWwindow* window,
58:                          float& shieldTimer, float& postHitInvulnTimer, bool isDashing,
59:                          int& coinsCollected, int& relicsTriggered, float& scoreDistance,
60:                          bool& requestExitToRunner, RunDirection& exitDir, bool& requestSkyFall)
61: {
62:     requestExitToRunner = false;
63:     requestSkyFall = false;
64:     (void)postHitInvulnTimer;
65: 
66:     scenePlayTime += deltaTime;
67:     if (scenePlayTime >= SCENE_DIRECTION_COOLDOWN && !directionUnlockedNotified) {
68:         directionUnlockedNotified = true;
69:         audioMgr.play(SFX_RELIC);
70:         spawnFloatingText("=== EXIT APPEARED! ===", glm::vec2(playerX, playerY + 1.2f),
71:                           glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f, 1.0f), 0.32f, 0.46f, 3.2f, 1.3f);
72:         showCornerNotification("EXIT", "=== EXIT APPEARED! ===", "Direction Arrow Relics spawned! Climb into an arrow to return!", glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f), 1, 0);
73: 
74:         // Spawn Left and Right Direction Arrow Relics visibly ahead on the tracks
75:         items.push_back({ 0, playerY + 5.2f, 2, DIR_LEFT, false });
76:         items.push_back({ 2, playerY + 8.2f, 2, DIR_RIGHT, false });
77:         items.push_back({ 1, playerY + 11.8f, 2, DIR_LEFT, false });
78:     }
79: 
80:     if (!isHit && !isResurrectingState) {
81:         playerY += climbSpeed * deltaTime;
82:         scoreDistance += climbSpeed * deltaTime;
83: 
84:         if (isLeaping) {
85:             leapProgress += deltaTime / LEAP_TIME;
86:             if (leapProgress >= 1.0f) {
87:                 leapProgress = 1.0f;
88:                 isLeaping = false;
89:                 currentLane = targetLane;
90:                 playerX = TRACK_X[currentLane];
91:             } else {
92:                 float fromX = TRACK_X[currentLane];
93:                 float toX   = TRACK_X[targetLane];
94:                 playerX = glm::mix(fromX, toX, leapProgress);
95:             }
96:         } else {
97:             playerX = TRACK_X[currentLane];
98:         }
99: 
100:         // Procedural generation of traps and items on 3 ladders
101:         while (genTopY < playerY + 25.0f) {
102:             genTopY += 4.5f;
103:             int trapLane = std::rand() % 3;
104:             traps.push_back({ trapLane, genTopY, std::rand() % 2, true });
105: 
106:             int itemLane = (trapLane + 1 + (std::rand() % 2)) % 3;
107:             if (scenePlayTime >= SCENE_DIRECTION_COOLDOWN) {
108:                 int roll = std::rand() % 10;
109:                 if (roll < 4) {
110:                     RunDirection arrowDir = (std::rand() % 2 == 0) ? DIR_LEFT : DIR_RIGHT;
111:                     items.push_back({ itemLane, genTopY + 1.2f, 2, arrowDir, false });
112:                 } else if (roll < 7) {
113:                     items.push_back({ itemLane, genTopY + 1.2f, 1, std::rand() % 4, false }); // Shield pickup
114:                 } else {
115:                     items.push_back({ itemLane, genTopY + 1.2f, 0, 0, false }); // Coin
116:                 }
117:             } else {
118:                 if (std::rand() % 2 == 0) {
119:                     items.push_back({ itemLane, genTopY + 1.2f, 1, std::rand() % 4, false });
120:                 } else {
121:                     items.push_back({ itemLane, genTopY + 1.2f, 0, 0, false });
122:                 }
123:             }
124:         }
125: 
126:         // Trap collisions
127:         for (auto& trap : traps) {
128:             if (trap.active && trap.lane == currentLane && std::abs(playerY - trap.y) < 0.9f) {
129:                 if (shieldTimer > 0.0f || isDashing) {
130:                     trap.active = false;
131:                     audioMgr.play(SFX_SLIDE);
132:                     if (shieldTimer > 0.0f && !isDashing) {
133:                         shieldTimer = 0.0f;
134:                         spawnFloatingText("SHIELD BROKE! [TRAP DEFLECTED]", glm::vec2(playerX, playerY + 1.0f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.95f, 1.0f));
135:                         showCornerNotification("SHIELD", "SHIELD BROKEN!", "Absorbed trap hit!", glm::vec4(0.3f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 1, 0);
136:                     } else {
137:                         spawnFloatingText("DASH DEFLECTED TRAP!", glm::vec2(playerX, playerY + 1.0f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.95f, 1.0f));
138:                     }
139:                 } else {
140:                     isHit = true;
141:                     hitVelY = -6.0f;
142:                     darkAlpha = 0.0f;
143:                     audioMgr.play(SFX_DEATH);
144:                     spawnFloatingText("STRUCK BY TRAP!", glm::vec2(playerX, playerY + 1.0f), glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.25f, 1.0f));
145:                     showCornerNotification("FALL", "KNOCKED OFF LADDER!", "Falling through the dark...", glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.2f, 1.0f), 0);
146:                     break;
147:                 }
148:             }
149:         }
150: 
151:         // Collectibles collisions (Coins, Shield Pickups & Direction Arrow Relics)
152:         for (auto& itm : items) {
153:             if (!itm.collected && itm.lane == currentLane && std::abs(playerY - itm.y) < 1.0f) {
154:                 itm.collected = true;
155:                 if (itm.type == 0) {
156:                     coinsCollected++;
157:                     audioMgr.play(SFX_COIN);
158:                     spawnFloatingText("+50", glm::vec2(playerX, itm.y + 0.5f), glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.88f, 0.2f, 1.0f));
159:                 } else if (itm.type == 1) {
160:                     shieldTimer = 10.0f;
161:                     audioMgr.play(SFX_RELIC);
162:                     showCornerNotification("SHIELD", "10s ENERGY SHIELD!", "Absorbs 1 hazard hit!", glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 1, itm.fruitType);
163:                     spawnFloatingText("+10s ENERGY SHIELD!", glm::vec2(playerX, itm.y + 0.8f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.95f, 1.0f));
164:                 } else if (itm.type == 2) {
165:                     RunDirection targetDir = static_cast<RunDirection>(itm.fruitType);
166:                     audioMgr.play(SFX_RELIC);
167:                     relicsTriggered++;
168:                     if (targetDir == DIR_LEFT || targetDir == DIR_RIGHT) {
169:                         exitDir = targetDir;
170:                         requestExitToRunner = true;
171:                         std::string dirStr = (targetDir == DIR_LEFT) ? "WARP <<< LEFT" : "WARP >>> RIGHT";
172:                         spawnFloatingText("DIRECTION TRIGGERED!\n" + dirStr, glm::vec2(playerX, itm.y + 0.8f),
173:                                           glm::vec4(0.25f, 1.0f, 0.95f, 1.0f), 0.28f, 0.40f, 2.8f, 1.3f);
174:                         showCornerNotification("WARP", dirStr, "Exiting ladder climb to platform runner!", glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 1, 0);
175:                         break;
176:                     } else if (targetDir == DIR_DOWN) {
177:                         requestSkyFall = true;
178:                         spawnFloatingText("WARP vvv SKY-FALL", glm::vec2(playerX, itm.y + 0.8f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f));
179:                         break;
180:                     }
181:                 }
182:             }
183:         }
184:     } else if (isHit) {
185:         playerY += hitVelY * deltaTime;
186:         hitVelY -= 22.0f * deltaTime;
187:         darkAlpha = std::min(1.0f, darkAlpha + deltaTime * 1.5f);
188:         if (darkAlpha >= 0.95f) {
189:             isHit = false;
190:             isResurrectingState = true;
191:             resurrectTimer = 0.0f;
192:         }
193:     } else if (isResurrectingState) {
194:         resurrectTimer += deltaTime;
195:         if (resurrectTimer >= 1.25f) {
196:             isResurrectingState = false;
197:             requestExitToRunner = true;
198:             exitDir = platformerSavedDir;
199:         }
200:     }
201: 
202:     // Lane switching input with A/D or Left/Right
203:     if (!isHit && !isResurrectingState && !isLeaping) {
204:         static bool aKeyLast = false;
205:         static bool dKeyLast = false;
206:         bool aPress = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_A) == GLFW_PRESS) || (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_LEFT) == GLFW_PRESS);
207:         bool dPress = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_D) == GLFW_PRESS) || (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_RIGHT) == GLFW_PRESS);
208: 
209:         if (aPress && !aKeyLast) {
210:             if (currentLane > 0) {
211:                 targetLane = currentLane - 1;
212:                 isLeaping = true;
213:                 leapProgress = 0.0f;
214:                 audioMgr.play(SFX_JUMP);
215:             }
216:         }
217:         if (dPress && !dKeyLast) {
218:             if (currentLane < 2) {
219:                 targetLane = currentLane + 1;
220:                 isLeaping = true;
221:                 leapProgress = 0.0f;
222:                 audioMgr.play(SFX_JUMP);
223:             }
224:         }
225:         aKeyLast = aPress;
226:         dKeyLast = dPress;
227:     }
228: }
229: 
230: void LadderScene::render(const glm::mat4& view, const glm::mat4& projection, const glm::vec2& cameraPos,
231:                          float animTimer, float daylightFactor, float twilightFactor,
232:                          unsigned int tilesetTex, unsigned int coinTex, unsigned int shieldTex, unsigned int arrowTex,
233:                          unsigned int sceneryTex, unsigned int spikesTex, float shieldTimerVal, const glm::vec2& playerRenderSize)
234: {
235:     // Thematic Scenery Backdrop behind ladders
236:     glm::vec4 nightSceneryTint(0.42f, 0.48f, 0.70f, 1.0f);
237:     glm::vec4 sunsetSceneryTint(1.08f, 0.72f, 0.58f, 1.0f);
238:     glm::vec4 daySceneryTint(1.02f, 1.0f, 0.98f, 1.0f);
239:     glm::vec4 curSceneryTint = glm::mix(nightSceneryTint, daySceneryTint, daylightFactor);
240:     curSceneryTint = glm::mix(curSceneryTint, sunsetSceneryTint, twilightFactor * 0.55f);
241: 
242:     glm::mat4 modelScenery = glm::mat4(1.0f);
243:     modelScenery = glm::translate(modelScenery, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
244:     modelScenery = glm::scale(modelScenery, glm::vec3(28.0f, 18.0f, 1.0f));
245:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelScenery, view, projection, curSceneryTint * 0.72f,
246:                           (sceneryTex != 0), glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), sceneryTex);
247: 
248:     // 1. Dark Vertical Tower Backdrop
249:     for (int i = -4; i <= 4; ++i) {
250:         float bgX = i * 4.0f;
251:         glm::mat4 modelBg = glm::mat4(1.0f);
252:         modelBg = glm::translate(modelBg, glm::vec3(bgX, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
253:         modelBg = glm::scale(modelBg, glm::vec3(2.6f, 32.0f, 1.0f));
254:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBg, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.07f, 0.09f, 0.15f, 0.90f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
255:     }
256: 
257:     // 2. Render 3 Infinite Parallel Ladders
258:     for (int lane = 0; lane < 3; ++lane) {
259:         float lx = TRACK_X[lane];
260:         float minY = std::floor(cameraPos.y - 12.0f);
261:         float maxY = std::ceil(cameraPos.y + 12.0f);
262: 
263:         // Left & Right ladder rails
264:         glm::mat4 modelRailL = glm::mat4(1.0f);
265:         modelRailL = glm::translate(modelRailL, glm::vec3(lx - 0.72f, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
266:         modelRailL = glm::scale(modelRailL, glm::vec3(0.18f, 24.0f, 1.0f));
267:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelRailL, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.48f, 0.34f, 0.20f, 1.0f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
268: 
269:         glm::mat4 modelRailR = glm::mat4(1.0f);
270:         modelRailR = glm::translate(modelRailR, glm::vec3(lx + 0.72f, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
271:         modelRailR = glm::scale(modelRailR, glm::vec3(0.18f, 24.0f, 1.0f));
272:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelRailR, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.48f, 0.34f, 0.20f, 1.0f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
273: 
274:         // Ladder Rungs
275:         for (float ry = minY; ry <= maxY; ry += 0.85f) {
276:             glm::mat4 modelRung = glm::mat4(1.0f);
277:             modelRung = glm::translate(modelRung, glm::vec3(lx, ry, 0.0f));
278:             modelRung = glm::scale(modelRung, glm::vec3(1.30f, 0.24f, 1.0f));
279:             glm::vec4 rungUV = getTilesetUV(9, 4);
280:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelRung, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (tilesetTex != 0), rungUV, tilesetTex);
281:         }
282:     }
283: 
284:     // 3. Render Ladder Traps (Spikes / Sawblades)
285:     // 3. Render Spikes on Ladder Track
286:     for (const auto& trap : traps) {
287:         if (!trap.active) continue;
288:         float tx = TRACK_X[trap.lane];
289:         glm::mat4 modelTrap = glm::mat4(1.0f);
290:         modelTrap = glm::translate(modelTrap, glm::vec3(tx, trap.y, 0.0f));
291:         modelTrap = glm::scale(modelTrap, glm::vec3(1.35f, 1.35f, 1.0f));
292:         if (spikesTex != 0) {
293:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelTrap, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), true, glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), spikesTex);
294:         } else {
295:             glm::vec4 trapUV = getTilesetUV(4, 8);
296:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelTrap, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.3f, 0.3f, 1.0f), (tilesetTex != 0), trapUV, tilesetTex);
297:         }
298:     }
299: 
300:     // 4. Render Ladder Collectibles (Coins, Shield Pickups & Direction Arrow Relics)
301:     for (const auto& itm : items) {
302:         if (itm.collected) continue;
303:         float ix = TRACK_X[itm.lane];
304:         if (itm.type == 0) {
305:             glm::mat4 modelCoin = glm::mat4(1.0f);
306:             modelCoin = glm::translate(modelCoin, glm::vec3(ix, itm.y, 0.0f));
307:             modelCoin = glm::scale(modelCoin, glm::vec3(0.9f, 0.9f, 1.0f));
308:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelCoin, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (coinTex != 0), getCoinUV(0), coinTex);
309:         } else if (itm.type == 1) {
310:             glm::mat4 modelShield = glm::mat4(1.0f);
311:             modelShield = glm::translate(modelShield, glm::vec3(ix, itm.y, 0.0f));
312:             modelShield = glm::scale(modelShield, glm::vec3(1.2f, 1.2f, 1.0f));
313:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelShield, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (shieldTex != 0), getShieldUV(itm.fruitType), shieldTex);
314:         } else if (itm.type == 2) {
315:             RunDirection relicDir = static_cast<RunDirection>(itm.fruitType);
316:             float pulse = 1.35f + 0.15f * std::sin(animTimer * 5.0f);
317:             glm::mat4 modelRelic = glm::mat4(1.0f);
318:             modelRelic = glm::translate(modelRelic, glm::vec3(ix, itm.y, 0.0f));
319:             modelRelic = glm::scale(modelRelic, glm::vec3(pulse, pulse, 1.0f));
320: 
321:             glm::vec4 arrowUV = getDirectionArrowUV(relicDir);
322:             glm::vec4 arrowTint(1.0f);
323:             if (relicDir == DIR_LEFT)       arrowTint = glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
324:             else if (relicDir == DIR_RIGHT) arrowTint = glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
325:             else if (relicDir == DIR_DOWN)  arrowTint = glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f);
326: 
327:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelRelic, view, projection, arrowTint, (arrowTex != 0), arrowUV, arrowTex);
328:         }
329:     }
330: 
331:     // 5. Render Character on Ladder (Climber, Falling, or Reverse Death Resurrection!)
332:     CharacterAnimSet& activeSet = samuraiAnim;
333:     if (isResurrectingState) {
334:         glm::mat4 modelDark = glm::mat4(1.0f);
335:         modelDark = glm::translate(modelDark, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
336:         modelDark = glm::scale(modelDark, glm::vec3(30.0f, 20.0f, 1.0f));
337:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelDark, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.01f, 0.02f, 0.04f, 0.94f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
338: 
339:         glm::mat4 modelSpot = glm::mat4(1.0f);
340:         modelSpot = glm::translate(modelSpot, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y - 0.2f, 0.0f));
341:         modelSpot = glm::scale(modelSpot, glm::vec3(4.8f, 4.8f, 1.0f));
342:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelSpot, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 0.28f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
343: 
344:         int totalFrames = activeSet.deathFrames;
345:         int frameIdx = std::clamp(totalFrames - 1 - static_cast<int>(resurrectTimer * 5.0f), 0, totalFrames - 1);
346:         float u = static_cast<float>(frameIdx) / static_cast<float>(totalFrames);
347:         float du = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(totalFrames);
348:         glm::vec4 uvRect(u, 0.0f, du, 1.0f);
349: 
350:         glm::mat4 modelHero = glm::mat4(1.0f);
351:         modelHero = glm::translate(modelHero, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y - 0.10f, 0.0f));
352:         modelHero = glm::scale(modelHero, glm::vec3(playerRenderSize.x, playerRenderSize.y, 1.0f));
353:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelHero, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (activeSet.texDeath != 0), uvRect, activeSet.texDeath);
354: 
355:         std::string rezText = "=== RESURRECTION... RISE! ===";
356:         float rezW = rezText.length() * 0.30f;
357:         gameRenderer.drawText(rezText, cameraPos.x - rezW * 0.5f, cameraPos.y + 2.2f, 0.30f, 0.42f,
358:                               glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.3f, 1.0f), projection, view);
359:     } else {
360:         unsigned int activeTex = isLeaping ? activeSet.texJump : activeSet.texJump;
361:         int totalFrames = activeSet.jumpFrames;
362:         int frameIdx = 0;
363: 
364:         if (isHit) {
365:             activeTex = activeSet.texFall;
366:             totalFrames = activeSet.fallFrames;
367:             frameIdx = 0;
368:         } else if (!isLeaping) {
369:             int climbStep = static_cast<int>(animTimer * 4.0f) % 2;
370:             activeTex = (climbStep == 0) ? activeSet.texJump : activeSet.texFall;
371:             totalFrames = (climbStep == 0) ? activeSet.jumpFrames : activeSet.fallFrames;
372:         }
373: 
374:         float u = static_cast<float>(frameIdx) / static_cast<float>(totalFrames);
375:         float du = 1.0f / static_cast<float>(totalFrames);
376:         glm::vec4 uvRect(u, 0.0f, du, 1.0f);
377: 
378:         glm::mat4 modelHero = glm::mat4(1.0f);
379:         modelHero = glm::translate(modelHero, glm::vec3(playerX, playerY - 0.10f, 0.0f));
380:         modelHero = glm::scale(modelHero, glm::vec3(playerRenderSize.x, playerRenderSize.y, 1.0f));
381:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelHero, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (activeTex != 0), uvRect, activeTex);
382: 
383:         // Circular shield bubble
384:         if (shieldTimerVal > 0.0f) {
385:             float shieldPulse = 1.0f + std::sin(animTimer * 8.0f) * 0.06f;
386:             glm::mat4 modelShield = glm::mat4(1.0f);
387:             modelShield = glm::translate(modelShield, glm::vec3(playerX, playerY, 0.0f));
388:             modelShield = glm::scale(modelShield, glm::vec3(2.35f * shieldPulse, 2.35f * shieldPulse, 1.0f));
389:             float sAlpha = std::min(0.70f, 0.35f + (shieldTimerVal / 10.0f) * 0.35f);
390:             gameRenderer.drawCircle(modelShield, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.85f, 1.0f, sAlpha), 2.2f);
391:         }
392: 
393:         if (darkAlpha > 0.01f) {
394:             glm::mat4 modelDark = glm::mat4(1.0f);
395:             modelDark = glm::translate(modelDark, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
396:             modelDark = glm::scale(modelDark, glm::vec3(30.0f, 20.0f, 1.0f));
397:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelDark, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, darkAlpha), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
398:         }
399:     }
400: }
````

````text
182: 
183:         // Spike collisions

264: void SkyFallScene::render(const glm::mat4& view, const glm::mat4& projection, const glm::vec2& cameraPos,
265:                           float animTimer, float daylightFactor, float twilightFactor,
266:                           unsigned int birdTex, unsigned int tilesetTex, unsigned int coinTex,
267:                           unsigned int shieldTex, unsigned int arrowTex, unsigned int sceneryTex,
268:                           unsigned int spikesTex, float shieldTimerVal, const glm::vec2& playerRenderSize)
269: {
270:     // Celestial Stars in night sky
271:     if (daylightFactor < 0.75f) {
272:         float starAlpha = (1.0f - daylightFactor) * 0.95f;
273:         for (const auto& star : stars) {
274:             float tw = 0.5f + 0.5f * std::sin(animTimer * star.twinkleFreq + star.twinklePhase);
275:             float a = starAlpha * tw;
276:             if (a > 0.04f) {
277:                 glm::mat4 modelStar = glm::mat4(1.0f);
278:                 modelStar = glm::translate(modelStar, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x * 0.05f + star.x, cameraPos.y * 0.05f + star.y, 0.0f));
279:                 modelStar = glm::scale(modelStar, glm::vec3(star.size, star.size, 1.0f));
280:                 gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelStar, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 0.95f, a), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
281:             }
282:         }
283:     }
284: 
285:     // Distant Scenery Backdrop
286:     glm::vec4 nightSceneryTint(0.42f, 0.48f, 0.70f, 1.0f);
287:     glm::vec4 sunsetSceneryTint(1.08f, 0.72f, 0.58f, 1.0f);
288:     glm::vec4 daySceneryTint(1.02f, 1.0f, 0.98f, 1.0f);
289:     glm::vec4 curSceneryTint = glm::mix(nightSceneryTint, daySceneryTint, daylightFactor);
290:     curSceneryTint = glm::mix(curSceneryTint, sunsetSceneryTint, twilightFactor * 0.55f);
291: 
292:     glm::mat4 modelScenery = glm::mat4(1.0f);
293:     modelScenery = glm::translate(modelScenery, glm::vec3(cameraPos.x, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
294:     modelScenery = glm::scale(modelScenery, glm::vec3(30.0f, 18.0f, 1.0f));
295:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelScenery, view, projection, curSceneryTint * 0.65f,
296:                           (sceneryTex != 0), glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), sceneryTex);
297: 
298:     // 1. Endless Sky Clouds Backdrop
299:     for (int i = -4; i <= 4; ++i) {
300:         float bgX = i * 4.0f;
301:         glm::mat4 modelBg = glm::mat4(1.0f);
302:         modelBg = glm::translate(modelBg, glm::vec3(bgX, cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
303:         modelBg = glm::scale(modelBg, glm::vec3(2.5f, 30.0f, 1.0f));
304:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBg, view, projection, glm::vec4(0.14f, 0.24f, 0.40f, 0.75f), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
305:     }
306: 
307:     // 2. Render Floating Spike Traps
308:     for (const auto& trap : spikes) {
309:         if (!trap.active) continue;
310:         glm::mat4 modelTrap = glm::mat4(1.0f);
311:         modelTrap = glm::translate(modelTrap, glm::vec3(trap.pos.x, trap.pos.y, 0.0f));
312:         modelTrap = glm::scale(modelTrap, glm::vec3(1.3f, 1.3f, 1.0f));
313:         if (spikesTex != 0) {
314:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelTrap, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), true, glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f), spikesTex);
315:         } else {
316:             glm::vec4 trapUV = getTilesetUV(4, 8);
317:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelTrap, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.35f, 1.0f), (tilesetTex != 0), trapUV, tilesetTex);
318:         }
319:     }
320: 
321:     // 3. Render Moving Birds (Flapping Raptor Asset)
322:     for (const auto& bird : birds) {
323:         if (!bird.active) continue;
324:         int bFrame = static_cast<int>(bird.animTimer * 7.0f) % 4;
325:         float u = bFrame * 0.25f;
326:         float du = 0.25f;
327:         glm::vec4 birdUV = (bird.vx < 0.0f) ? glm::vec4(u + du, 0.0f, -du, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(u, 0.0f, du, 1.0f);
328: 
329:         glm::mat4 modelBird = glm::mat4(1.0f);
330:         modelBird = glm::translate(modelBird, glm::vec3(bird.pos.x, bird.pos.y, 0.0f));
331:         modelBird = glm::scale(modelBird, glm::vec3(2.4f, 2.4f, 1.0f));
332:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBird, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (birdTex != 0), birdUV, birdTex);
333:     }
334: 
335:     // 4. Render Sky Collectibles (Coins, Shield Pickups & Direction Arrow Relics)
336:     for (const auto& itm : items) {
337:         if (itm.collected) continue;
338:         if (itm.type == 0) {
339:             glm::mat4 modelCoin = glm::mat4(1.0f);
340:             modelCoin = glm::translate(modelCoin, glm::vec3(itm.pos.x, itm.pos.y, 0.0f));
341:             modelCoin = glm::scale(modelCoin, glm::vec3(0.9f, 0.9f, 1.0f));
342:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelCoin, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (coinTex != 0), getCoinUV(0), coinTex);
343:         } else if (itm.type == 1) {
344:             glm::mat4 modelShield = glm::mat4(1.0f);
345:             modelShield = glm::translate(modelShield, glm::vec3(itm.pos.x, itm.pos.y, 0.0f));
346:             modelShield = glm::scale(modelShield, glm::vec3(1.2f, 1.2f, 1.0f));
347:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelShield, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f), (shieldTex != 0), getShieldUV(itm.fruitType), shieldTex);
348:         } else if (itm.type == 2) {
349:             RunDirection relicDir = static_cast<RunDirection>(itm.fruitType);
350:             float pulse = 1.65f + 0.20f * std::sin(animTimer * 5.0f);
351:             glm::mat4 modelRelic = glm::mat4(1.0f);
352:             modelRelic = glm::translate(modelRelic, glm::vec3(itm.pos.x, itm.pos.y, 0.0f));
353:             modelRelic = glm::scale(modelRelic, glm::vec3(pulse, pulse, 1.0f));
354: 
355:             glm::vec4 arrowUV = getDirectionArrowUV(relicDir);
356:             glm::vec4 arrowTint(1.0f);
357:             if (relicDir == DIR_LEFT)       arrowTint = glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
358:             else if (relicDir == DIR_RIGHT) arrowTint = glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
359:             else if (relicDir == DIR_UP)    arrowTint = glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.35f, 0.35f, 1.0f);
360: 
361:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelRelic, view, projection, arrowTint, (arrowTex != 0), arrowUV, arrowTex);
362:         }
363:     }
364: 
365:     // 5. Render Character in Sky-Fall (or Take Hit rotated 90 deg CCW!)
366:     CharacterAnimSet& activeSet = samuraiAnim;
367:     if (isHit) {
368:         unsigned int hitTex = (activeSet.texTakeHit != 0) ? activeSet.texTakeHit : activeSet.texDeath;
369:         int totalFrames = (activeSet.texTakeHit != 0) ? activeSet.takeHitFrames : activeSet.deathFrames;
370:         int fIdx = std::clamp(static_cast<int>(hitTimer * 6.0f), 0, totalFrames - 1);
371:         float u = static_cast<float>(fIdx) / static_cast<float>(totalFrames);
````

````text
86: std::vector<uint8_t> AudioManager::buildWav(const std::vector<int16_t>& samples, int sampleRate) {
87:     uint32_t dataSize = static_cast<uint32_t>(samples.size() * sizeof(int16_t));
88:     uint32_t totalSize = 36 + dataSize;
89:     std::vector<uint8_t> wav;
90:     wav.reserve(44 + dataSize);
91: 
92:     auto pushStr = [&](const char* s) { while (*s) wav.push_back((uint8_t)*s++); };
93:     auto push32 = [&](uint32_t val) {
94:         wav.push_back(val & 0xFF);
95:         wav.push_back((val >> 8) & 0xFF);
96:         wav.push_back((val >> 16) & 0xFF);
97:         wav.push_back((val >> 24) & 0xFF);
98:     };
99:     auto push16 = [&](uint16_t val) {
100:         wav.push_back(val & 0xFF);
101:         wav.push_back((val >> 8) & 0xFF);
102:     };
103: 
104:     pushStr("RIFF");
105:     push32(totalSize);
106:     pushStr("WAVE");
107:     pushStr("fmt ");
108:     push32(16);
109:     push16(1);              // PCM
110:     push16(1);              // Mono
111:     push32(sampleRate);
112:     push32(sampleRate * 2); // Byte rate
113:     push16(2);              // Block align
114:     push16(16);             // Bits per sample
115:     pushStr("data");
116:     push32(dataSize);
117: 
118:     for (int16_t s : samples) {
119:         push16(static_cast<uint16_t>(s));
120:     }
121:     return wav;
122: }

379:     // 16. SFX_HEART_PICKUP: Harmonic life restoration chime
380:     {

383:         for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {

385:             float env = (1.0f - t);
386:             float freq = (t < 0.33f) ? 523.25f : ((t < 0.66f) ? 659.25f : 783.99f); // C5 - E5 - G5
387:             float tone = std::sin(2.0f * PI * freq * ((float)i / sr));
388:             samples[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(tone * env * 17500.0f);

393:     // 17. SFX_BLOCK: Resonant Japanese katana parry & sword guard deflection (sharp metallic impact + sustained ringing steel)
394:     {
395:         int count = static_cast<int>(sr * 0.28f); // 280ms duration
396:         std::vector<int16_t> samples(count);
397:         for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
398:             float t = (float)i / count;
399:             float timeSec = (float)i / sr;
400: 
401:             // Sharp metallic impulse clink at t = 0 (first 12ms)
402:             float clinkEnv = (t < 0.05f) ? (1.0f - (t / 0.05f)) : 0.0f;
403:             float clinkNoise = ((float)(std::rand() % 2000) - 1000.0f) / 1000.0f;
404:             float clinkPulse = std::sin(2.0f * PI * 4800.0f * timeSec) * clinkEnv;
405: 
406:             // Dual resonant metallic steel chime harmonics with exponential ringing decay
407:             float ringEnv = std::exp(-timeSec * 16.0f);
408:             float ring1 = std::sin(2.0f * PI * 2850.0f * timeSec);
409:             float ring2 = std::sin(2.0f * PI * 4150.0f * timeSec);
410:             float ring3 = std::sin(2.0f * PI * 1650.0f * timeSec);
411:             float steelRing = (ring1 * 0.50f + ring2 * 0.35f + ring3 * 0.25f) * ringEnv;
412: 
413:             // Low body resonance ping (blade mass absorbing impact)
414:             float bodyEnv = std::exp(-timeSec * 30.0f);
415:             float bodyTone = std::sin(2.0f * PI * 420.0f * timeSec) * bodyEnv;
416: 
417:             float s = (clinkPulse * 0.40f + clinkNoise * clinkEnv * 0.30f + steelRing * 0.70f + bodyTone * 0.35f);
418:             samples[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(s * 22000.0f);
419:         }

421:     }
````

````text
7:         c = chunk_type + data
8:         crc = struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(c) & 0xffffffff)

18:     png += chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', width, height, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0))
19:     png += chunk(b'IDAT', compressed)

40:                 out_b = int((b * alpha_f + bb * (ba / 255.0) * (1.0 - alpha_f)) / (out_a / 255.0))
````

````text
224:     glm::vec4 heartCol = hasLife ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.25f, 0.35f, 1.0f)
225:                                  : glm::vec4(0.35f, 0.38f, 0.45f, 0.45f);
226:     glm::vec4 heartUV = getHeartUV((frameCount / 6) % 4);
227:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelHeart, identityView, orthoUI, heartCol,
228:                           (heartTex != 0), heartUV, heartTex);
229:   }
230: 
231:   std::string scoreStr = "SCORE " + std::to_string(totalScore);
232:   std::string statsStr = "COIN " + std::to_string(coins) + "  DIST " +
233:                          std::to_string(static_cast<int>(distance)) + "m";
234:   if (shieldTimer > 0.0f) {
235:     statsStr += "  SHIELD " +
236:                 std::to_string(static_cast<int>(shieldTimer + 0.9f)) + "s";
237:   }
238:   if (isBlocking) {
239:     statsStr += "  [GUARD: ACTIVE]";
240:   } else if (blockCooldown > 0.0f) {
241:     char cdBuf[24];
242:     snprintf(cdBuf, sizeof(cdBuf), "  [DEF: %.1fs]", blockCooldown);
243:     statsStr += cdBuf;
244:   }
245:   gameRenderer.drawText(scoreStr, scoreCardX - (scoreCardW * 0.5f) + 1.25f,
246:                         scoreCardY + 0.16f, 0.26f, 0.38f,
247:                         glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.86f, 0.22f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
248:   glm::vec4 statsColor =
249:       isBlocking               ? glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.95f, 1.0f)
250:       : (blockCooldown > 0.0f) ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.35f, 1.0f)
251:       : (shieldTimer > 0.0f)   ? glm::vec4(0.3f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f)
252:                                : glm::vec4(0.85f, 0.94f, 1.0f, 0.95f);
253:   gameRenderer.drawText(statsStr, scoreCardX - (scoreCardW * 0.5f) + 1.25f,
254:                         scoreCardY - 0.38f, 0.18f, 0.27f, statsColor, orthoUI);
255: }
256: 
257: void UIManager::renderEnemyHealthBars(const glm::mat4 &view,
258:                                       const glm::mat4 &projection,
259:                                       const std::vector<EnemyEntity> &enemies,
260:                                       float animTimer) {
261:   (void)animTimer;
262:   for (const auto &enemy : enemies) {
263:     if (!enemy.active || enemy.state == ENEMY_STATE_DEATH)
264:       continue;
265: 
266:     bool isBoss = (enemy.type == ENEMY_BOSS_DEMON_SLIME);
267:     float barW = isBoss ? 3.4f : 1.5f;
268:     float barH = isBoss ? 0.32f : 0.18f;
269:     float barY = enemy.pos.y + (enemy.size.y * 0.5f) + (isBoss ? 0.55f : 0.32f);
270:     float barX = enemy.pos.x;
271: 
272:     // Background shadow / border
273:     glm::mat4 modelBg = glm::mat4(1.0f);
274:     modelBg = glm::translate(modelBg, glm::vec3(barX, barY, 0.0f));
275:     modelBg = glm::scale(modelBg, glm::vec3(barW + 0.12f, barH + 0.08f, 1.0f));
276:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBg, view, projection,
277:                           glm::vec4(0.04f, 0.04f, 0.08f, 0.92f), false,
278:                           glm::vec4(0), 0);
279: 
280:     // Health fill
281:     float hpRatio =
282:         (enemy.maxHp > 0)
283:             ? (static_cast<float>(enemy.hp) / static_cast<float>(enemy.maxHp))
284:             : 0.0f;
285:     hpRatio = std::max(0.0f, std::min(1.0f, hpRatio));
286:     float fillW = barW * hpRatio;
287:     float fillOffset = -(barW * 0.5f) + (fillW * 0.5f);
288: 
289:     glm::vec4 hpCol;
290:     if (isBoss) {
291:       hpCol = glm::vec4(0.95f, 0.15f, 0.15f, 1.0f); // Crimson demon boss
292:     } else if (enemy.type == ENEMY_SLIME_INITIAL) {
293:       hpCol = glm::vec4(0.20f, 0.88f, 0.35f, 1.0f); // Emerald slime
294:     } else {
295:       hpCol = glm::vec4(0.85f, 0.35f, 0.95f, 1.0f); // Violet bringer of death
296:     }
297: 
298:     if (fillW > 0.01f) {
299:       glm::mat4 modelFill = glm::mat4(1.0f);
300:       modelFill =
301:           glm::translate(modelFill, glm::vec3(barX + fillOffset, barY, 0.0f));
302:       modelFill = glm::scale(modelFill, glm::vec3(fillW, barH, 1.0f));
303:       gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelFill, view, projection, hpCol, false,
304:                             glm::vec4(0), 0);
305:     }
306: 
307:     // Draw segmented tick marks if maxHp > 1
308:     if (enemy.maxHp > 1) {
309:       for (int seg = 1; seg < enemy.maxHp; ++seg) {
310:         float segX = barX - (barW * 0.5f) + (barW / enemy.maxHp) * seg;
311:         glm::mat4 modelTick = glm::mat4(1.0f);
312:         modelTick = glm::translate(modelTick, glm::vec3(segX, barY, 0.0f));
313:         modelTick = glm::scale(modelTick, glm::vec3(0.04f, barH, 1.0f));
314:         gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelTick, view, projection,
315:                               glm::vec4(0.06f, 0.06f, 0.10f, 0.95f), false,
316:                               glm::vec4(0), 0);
317:       }
318:     }
319:   }
320: }
321: 
322: void UIManager::renderTrialBadge(float halfW, float halfH, float timeLeft,
323:                                  float totalTime, float animTimer) {
324:   glm::mat4 identityView = glm::mat4(1.0f);
325:   glm::mat4 orthoUI = glm::ortho(-halfW, halfW, -halfH, halfH, -1.0f, 1.0f);
326: 
327:   if (timeLeft > 0.0f) {
328:     float badgeW = 7.8f;
329:     float badgeH = 1.15f;
330:     float badgeY = halfH - 1.15f;
331: 
332:     glm::mat4 modelBadge = glm::mat4(1.0f);
333:     modelBadge = glm::translate(modelBadge, glm::vec3(0.0f, badgeY, 0.0f));
334:     modelBadge = glm::scale(modelBadge, glm::vec3(badgeW, badgeH, 1.0f));
335:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBadge, identityView, orthoUI,
336:                           glm::vec4(0.03f, 0.06f, 0.12f, 0.88f), false,
337:                           glm::vec4(0), 0);
338: 
339:     float pFrac = 1.0f - (timeLeft / totalTime);
340:     float barW = badgeW * pFrac;
341:     if (barW > 0.05f) {
342:       glm::mat4 modelPBar = glm::mat4(1.0f);
343:       modelPBar = glm::translate(
344:           modelPBar, glm::vec3(-badgeW * 0.5f + barW * 0.5f,
345:                                badgeY - (badgeH * 0.5f) + 0.05f, 0.0f));
346:       modelPBar = glm::scale(modelPBar, glm::vec3(barW, 0.09f, 1.0f));
347:       gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelPBar, identityView, orthoUI,
348:                             glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 0.95f), false,
349:                             glm::vec4(0), 0);
350:     }
351: 
352:     char buf[64];
353:     std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "SURVIVE UNTIL EXIT: %.1fs", timeLeft);
354:     std::string timerStr = buf;
355:     float tW = static_cast<float>(timerStr.length()) * 0.22f;
356:     glm::vec4 textCol = (timeLeft <= 3.0f)
357:                             ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.82f, 0.25f, 1.0f)
358:                             : glm::vec4(0.35f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
359:     gameRenderer.drawText(timerStr, -tW * 0.5f, badgeY - 0.12f, 0.22f, 0.32f,
360:                           textCol, orthoUI);
361:   } else {
362:     float bannerW = 10.6f;
363:     float bannerH = 1.45f;
364:     float bannerY = halfH - 1.25f;
365:     float pulse = 0.80f + 0.20f * std::sin(animTimer * 6.0f);
366: 
367:     glm::mat4 modelBanner = glm::mat4(1.0f);
368:     modelBanner = glm::translate(modelBanner, glm::vec3(0.0f, bannerY, 0.0f));
369:     modelBanner = glm::scale(modelBanner, glm::vec3(bannerW, bannerH, 1.0f));
370:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBanner, identityView, orthoUI,
371:                           glm::vec4(0.02f, 0.14f, 0.08f, 0.92f * pulse), false,
372:                           glm::vec4(0), 0);
373: 
374:     glm::mat4 modelStripe = glm::mat4(1.0f);
375:     modelStripe = glm::translate(
376:         modelStripe, glm::vec3(0.0f, bannerY + (bannerH * 0.5f) - 0.05f, 0.0f));
377:     modelStripe = glm::scale(modelStripe, glm::vec3(bannerW, 0.10f, 1.0f));
378:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelStripe, identityView, orthoUI,
379:                           glm::vec4(0.30f, 1.0f, 0.50f, 1.0f), false,
380:                           glm::vec4(0), 0);
381: 
382:     std::string exTitle = "=== EXIT APPEARED! ===";
383:     float exW = static_cast<float>(exTitle.length()) * 0.25f;
384:     gameRenderer.drawText(exTitle, -exW * 0.5f, bannerY + 0.14f, 0.25f, 0.38f,
385:                           glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
386: 
387:     std::string exSub = "TOUCH A DIRECTION ARROW TO RETURN";
388:     float subW = static_cast<float>(exSub.length()) * 0.18f;
389:     gameRenderer.drawText(exSub, -subW * 0.5f, bannerY - 0.38f, 0.18f, 0.26f,
390:                           glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.92f, 0.40f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
391:   }
392: }

394: void UIManager::renderStartHintBanner(float halfW, float halfH,

403: void UIManager::renderPauseMenu(float halfW, float halfH, int totalScore,
404:                                 int coins, int relics, float distance,
405:                                 bool freeExploration, int activeScenery,
406:                                 bool isNight, float timeLeftInPhase,
407:                                 bool autoShiftEnabled, bool bgmMuted) {
408:   glm::mat4 identityView = glm::mat4(1.0f);
409:   glm::mat4 orthoUI = glm::ortho(-halfW, halfW, -halfH, halfH, -1.0f, 1.0f);
410: 
411:   glm::mat4 modelOverlay = glm::mat4(1.0f);
412:   modelOverlay =
413:       glm::scale(modelOverlay, glm::vec3(halfW * 2.0f, halfH * 2.0f, 1.0f));
414:   gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelOverlay, identityView, orthoUI,
415:                         glm::vec4(0.02f, 0.03f, 0.06f, 0.78f), false,
416:                         glm::vec4(0), 0);
417: 
418:   float menuW = 13.2f;
419:   float menuH = 11.6f;
420:   glm::mat4 modelMenu = glm::mat4(1.0f);
421:   modelMenu = glm::scale(modelMenu, glm::vec3(menuW, menuH, 1.0f));
422:   gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelMenu, identityView, orthoUI,
423:                         glm::vec4(0.05f, 0.07f, 0.12f, 0.96f), false,
424:                         glm::vec4(0), 0);
425: 
426:   glm::mat4 modelHeaderStripe = glm::mat4(1.0f);
427:   modelHeaderStripe = glm::translate(
428:       modelHeaderStripe, glm::vec3(0.0f, menuH * 0.5f - 0.1f, 0.0f));
429:   modelHeaderStripe =
430:       glm::scale(modelHeaderStripe, glm::vec3(menuW, 0.2f, 1.0f));
431:   gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelHeaderStripe, identityView, orthoUI,
432:                         glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.82f, 0.20f, 1.0f), false,
433:                         glm::vec4(0), 0);
434: 
435:   float textX = -menuW * 0.5f + 0.9f;
436:   float curY = menuH * 0.5f - 0.85f;
437: 
438:   gameRenderer.drawText("=== GAME PAUSED ===", textX + 2.0f, curY, 0.34f, 0.48f,
439:                         glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.25f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
440:   curY -= 0.72f;
441: 
442:   gameRenderer.drawText("HERO: SAMURAI MACK [KATANA MASTER]", textX, curY,
443:                         0.22f, 0.32f, glm::vec4(0.35f, 0.95f, 1.0f, 1.0f),
444:                         orthoUI);
445:   curY -= 0.42f;
446: 
447:   gameRenderer.drawText("TOTAL SCORE: " + std::to_string(totalScore) + " PTS",
448:                         textX, curY, 0.23f, 0.34f,
449:                         glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.9f, 0.35f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
450:   curY -= 0.40f;
451: 
452:   gameRenderer.drawText(
453:       "DISTANCE: " + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(distance)) +
454:           "m   COINS: " + std::to_string(coins) +
455:           "   RELICS: " + std::to_string(relics),
456:       textX, curY, 0.19f, 0.28f, glm::vec4(0.85f, 0.92f, 0.98f, 0.95f),
457:       orthoUI);
458:   curY -= 0.48f;
459: 
460:   glm::mat4 modelDiv = glm::mat4(1.0f);
461:   modelDiv = glm::translate(modelDiv, glm::vec3(0.0f, curY + 0.12f, 0.0f));
462:   modelDiv = glm::scale(modelDiv, glm::vec3(menuW - 1.8f, 0.05f, 1.0f));
463:   gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelDiv, identityView, orthoUI,
464:                         glm::vec4(0.3f, 0.45f, 0.6f, 0.6f), false, glm::vec4(0),
465:                         0);
466:   curY -= 0.38f;
467: 
468:   gameRenderer.drawText("[ESC / SPACE]   RESUME GAME", textX, curY, 0.23f,
469:                         0.32f, glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
470:   curY -= 0.42f;
471: 
472:   std::string modeMenuStr = freeExploration
473:                                 ? "FREE EXPLORATION (DEFAULT) [MANUAL A/D]"
474:                                 : "AUTO-RUNNER [CONTINUOUS SPRINT]";
475:   glm::vec4 modeMenuCol = freeExploration ? glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f, 1.0f)
476:                                           : glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
477:   gameRenderer.drawText("[F]             MODE: " + modeMenuStr, textX, curY,
478:                         0.20f, 0.28f, modeMenuCol, orthoUI);
479:   curY -= 0.42f;
480: 
481:   std::string musicStr =
482:       bgmMuted ? "MUTED [Press M to Unmute]" : "50% VOLUME [Press M to Mute]";
483:   glm::vec4 musicCol = bgmMuted ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
484:                                 : glm::vec4(0.40f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
485:   gameRenderer.drawText("[M]             BGM MUSIC: " + musicStr, textX, curY,
486:                         0.20f, 0.28f, musicCol, orthoUI);
487:   curY -= 0.42f;
488: 
489:   std::string shiftStr =
490:       autoShiftEnabled ? "AUTO TIMER (6.5s)" : "MANUAL (RELICS ONLY)";
491:   glm::vec4 shiftCol = autoShiftEnabled ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.65f, 0.25f, 1.0f)
492:                                         : glm::vec4(0.4f, 0.95f, 0.5f, 1.0f);
493:   gameRenderer.drawText("[Y]             SHIFT MODE: " + shiftStr, textX, curY,
494:                         0.20f, 0.28f, shiftCol, orthoUI);
495:   curY -= 0.42f;
496: 
497:   std::string scenStr = (activeScenery == 0)   ? "SILVERGRASS FIELD"
498:                         : (activeScenery == 1) ? "AUTUMN FOLIAGE"
499:                         : (activeScenery == 2) ? "GREEN FOREST"
500:                                                : "URBAN AREA";
501:   gameRenderer.drawText("[B]             SCENERY: " + scenStr, textX, curY,
502:                         0.22f, 0.30f, glm::vec4(0.3f, 0.95f, 0.85f, 1.0f),
503:                         orthoUI);
504:   curY -= 0.42f;
505: 
506:   std::string cycleStr = (isNight ? "NIGHT TIME (" : "DAY TIME (") +
507:                          std::to_string(static_cast<int>(timeLeftInPhase)) +
508:                          "s left)";
509:   gameRenderer.drawText("[N]             CYCLE: " + cycleStr, textX, curY,
510:                         0.22f, 0.30f,
511:                         isNight ? glm::vec4(0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 1.0f)
512:                                 : glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.35f, 1.0f),
513:                         orthoUI);
514:   curY -= 0.42f;
515: 
516:   gameRenderer.drawText("[T]             TUTORIAL / HOW TO PLAY", textX, curY,
517:                         0.22f, 0.30f, glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.65f, 1.0f),
518:                         orthoUI);
519:   curY -= 0.42f;
520: 
521:   gameRenderer.drawText("[R]             RESTART RUN", textX, curY, 0.22f,
522:                         0.30f, glm::vec4(0.95f, 0.85f, 0.3f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
523:   curY -= 0.42f;
524: 
525:   gameRenderer.drawText("[Q]             QUIT TO DESKTOP", textX, curY, 0.22f,
526:                         0.30f, glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.4f, 0.4f, 1.0f), orthoUI);
527:   curY -= 0.48f;
528: 
529:   gameRenderer.drawText(
530:       "CONTROLS: [A/D] MOVE  [W/SPACE] JUMP/CLIMB  [S] SLIDE  [SHIFT] DASH  "
531:       "[L-CLICK] ATK  [R-CLICK] BLOCK  [F] MODE  [M] BGM",
532:       textX - 0.45f, curY, 0.128f, 0.18f, glm::vec4(0.6f, 0.7f, 0.85f, 0.8f),
533:       orthoUI);
534: }

728: void UIManager::renderSplashScreen(float halfW, float halfH, float fadeAlpha,
729:                                    float progress) {
730:   glm::mat4 identityView = glm::mat4(1.0f);
731:   glm::mat4 orthoUI = glm::ortho(-halfW, halfW, -halfH, halfH, -1.0f, 1.0f);
732: 
733:   // Lambda helpers for vector lines and quads
734:   auto drawHLine = [&](float x1, float x2, float y, const glm::vec4 &col,
735:                        float thickness = 0.025f) {
736:     float w = x2 - x1;
737:     glm::mat4 m = glm::mat4(1.0f);
738:     m = glm::translate(m, glm::vec3((x1 + x2) * 0.5f, y, 0.0f));
739:     m = glm::scale(m, glm::vec3(w, thickness, 1.0f));
740:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(m, identityView, orthoUI, col, false, glm::vec4(0),
741:                           0);
742:   };
743: 
744:   auto drawVLine = [&](float x, float y1, float y2, const glm::vec4 &col,
745:                        float thickness = 0.025f) {
746:     float h = y2 - y1;
747:     glm::mat4 m = glm::mat4(1.0f);
748:     m = glm::translate(m, glm::vec3(x, (y1 + y2) * 0.5f, 0.0f));
749:     m = glm::scale(m, glm::vec3(thickness, h, 1.0f));
750:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(m, identityView, orthoUI, col, false, glm::vec4(0),
751:                           0);
752:   };
753: 
754:   auto drawFilledRect = [&](float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2,
755:                             const glm::vec4 &col) {
756:     float w = x2 - x1;
757:     float h = y2 - y1;
758:     glm::mat4 m = glm::mat4(1.0f);
759:     m = glm::translate(m, glm::vec3((x1 + x2) * 0.5f, (y1 + y2) * 0.5f, 0.0f));
760:     m = glm::scale(m, glm::vec3(w, h, 1.0f));
761:     gameRenderer.drawQuad(m, identityView, orthoUI, col, false, glm::vec4(0),
762:                           0);
763:   };
764: 
765:   // 1. Dark Cinematic Studio Backdrop
766:   glm::mat4 modelBackdrop = glm::mat4(1.0f);
767:   modelBackdrop =
768:       glm::scale(modelBackdrop, glm::vec3(halfW * 2.0f, halfH * 2.0f, 1.0f));
769:   gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelBackdrop, identityView, orthoUI,
770:                         glm::vec4(0.02f, 0.025f, 0.04f, 1.0f), false,
771:                         glm::vec4(0), 0);
772: 
773:   // 2. Main Academic Card Dimensions
774:   float cardW = 15.6f;
775:   float cardH = 8.60f;
776:   float cardCenterY = 0.35f;
777: 
778:   // Ambient drop shadow
779:   drawFilledRect(-cardW * 0.5f - 0.12f, cardCenterY - cardH * 0.5f - 0.12f,
780:                  cardW * 0.5f + 0.12f, cardCenterY + cardH * 0.5f + 0.12f,
781:                  glm::vec4(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.65f * fadeAlpha));
782: 
783:   // Outer cyan accent frame
784:   drawFilledRect(-cardW * 0.5f - 0.035f, cardCenterY - cardH * 0.5f - 0.035f,
785:                  cardW * 0.5f + 0.035f, cardCenterY + cardH * 0.5f + 0.035f,
786:                  glm::vec4(0.20f, 0.65f, 0.95f, 0.85f * fadeAlpha));
787: 
788:   // Card background body
789:   drawFilledRect(-cardW * 0.5f, cardCenterY - cardH * 0.5f, cardW * 0.5f,
790:                  cardCenterY + cardH * 0.5f,
791:                  glm::vec4(0.04f, 0.065f, 0.11f, 0.98f * fadeAlpha));
792:

795:                  cardW * 0.5f, cardCenterY + cardH * 0.5f,
796:                  glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.80f, 1.0f, 0.95f * fadeAlpha));

800:   float titleCharW = 0.22f, titleCharH = 0.34f;
````

````text
223:             targetPillarColor = glm::vec4(0.20f, 0.12f, 0.28f, 0.55f);
224:             targetTileTint    = glm::vec4(0.92f, 0.84f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
225:             break;
226:         default:
227:             break;
228:     }
229: }

231: std::string getSceneryName(SceneryTheme s) {
232:     switch (s) {
233:         case SCENERY_SILVERGRASS: return "SILVERGRASS FIELD";
234:         case SCENERY_AUTUMN:      return "AUTUMN FOLIAGE";
235:         case SCENERY_FOREST:      return "GREEN FOREST FOLIAGE";
236:         case SCENERY_URBAN:       return "URBAN AREA";
237:         default:                  return "UNKNOWN";
238:     }
239: }

241: void setSceneryTheme(SceneryTheme s) {
242:     activeScenery = s;
243:     std::string name = getSceneryName(s);
244:     glm::vec4 accent(1.0f);
245:     if (s == SCENERY_SILVERGRASS) accent = glm::vec4(0.85f, 0.9f, 0.75f, 1.0f);
246:     else if (s == SCENERY_AUTUMN) accent = glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.55f, 0.2f, 1.0f);
247:     else if (s == SCENERY_FOREST) accent = glm::vec4(0.3f, 0.95f, 0.45f, 1.0f);
248:     else if (s == SCENERY_URBAN)  accent = glm::vec4(0.4f, 0.8f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
249:     showCornerNotification("SCENERY", name, "Backdrop scenery shifted!", accent, 1, 0);
250:     spawnFloatingText("SCENERY: " + name, (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER ? playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.2f) : glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f)), accent);
251: }

253: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
254: // Scene Transitions: Up Ladder Climb, Down Sky-Fall, and Platformer Return
255: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
256: void enterLadderScene() {
257:     currentScene = SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB;
258:     platformerSavedPos = playerPos;
259:     platformerSavedDir = lastHorizontalDir;
260:     scenePlayTime = 0.0f;
261:     sceneDirectionUnlockedNotified = false;
262:     exitAppearedBannerTimer = 0.0f;
263:     gameLadderScene.enter(playerPos, lastHorizontalDir);
264: }
265: 
266: void enterSkyFallScene() {
267:     currentScene = SCENE_SKY_FALL;
268:     platformerSavedPos = playerPos;
269:     platformerSavedDir = lastHorizontalDir;
270:     scenePlayTime = 0.0f;
271:     sceneDirectionUnlockedNotified = false;
272:     exitAppearedBannerTimer = 0.0f;
273:     gameSkyFallScene.enter(playerPos, lastHorizontalDir);
274: }
275: 
276: void returnToPlatformerScene(bool fromJump) {
277:     currentScene = SCENE_PLATFORMER;
278:     // Guarantee that left and right chunks around saved return point are generated
279:     gameWorld.ensureGroundAround(platformerSavedPos.x, activeTheme);
280: 
281:     float dirSign = (platformerSavedDir == DIR_LEFT) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
282:     currentDirection = platformerSavedDir;
283:     lastHorizontalDir = platformerSavedDir;
284: 
285:     // Search for the highest solid ground/platform tile directly beneath platformerSavedPos.x
286:     float bestTopY = -999.0f;
287:     bool foundSolid = false;
288:     for (const auto& t : gameWorld.tiles) {
289:         if (!t.isLadder && std::abs(t.pos.x - platformerSavedPos.x) <= (t.size.x * 0.5f + 0.35f)) {
290:             float topY = t.pos.y + (t.size.y * 0.5f);
291:             if (topY <= platformerSavedPos.y + 0.8f && topY > bestTopY) {
292:                 bestTopY = topY;
293:                 foundSolid = true;
294:             }
295:         }
296:     }
297: 
298:     if (foundSolid) {
299:         playerPos = glm::vec2(platformerSavedPos.x, bestTopY + (playerHitbox.y * 0.5f));
300:         isGrounded = !fromJump;
301:         playerVel = glm::vec2(dirSign * BASE_RUN_SPEED, fromJump ? JUMP_BURST * 0.75f : 0.0f);
302:     } else {
303:         // Over a chasm or slope: keep in air with gravity active so the player falls safely, NEVER floating on air!
304:         playerPos = glm::vec2(platformerSavedPos.x, platformerSavedPos.y);
305:         isGrounded = false;
306:         playerVel = glm::vec2(dirSign * BASE_RUN_SPEED, fromJump ? JUMP_BURST * 0.75f : -1.5f);
307:     }
308: 
309:     isGameIdleAtStart = false;
310:     isOnLadder = false;
311:     isSliding = false;
312:     playerSpriteAngle = 0.0f;
313:     audioMgr.play(fromJump ? SFX_JUMP : SFX_STEP);
314:     spawnFloatingText("SURVIVED! BACK TO RUNNER!", playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.2f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.85f, 1.0f));
315:     showCornerNotification("RETURN", "BACK ON PLATFORM", "Resuming infinite sprint!", glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0);
316:     gameWorld.updateProcedural(playerPos.x, activeTheme);
317: }
318: 
319: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
320: // Dynamic Direction Shift
321: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
322: void triggerRandomDirectionShift(const std::string& sourceName, RunDirection forcedDir)
323: {
324:     directionShiftsCount++;
325:     RunDirection newDir = forcedDir;
326: 
327:     if ((int)forcedDir < 0) {
328:         int roll = std::rand() % 4;
329:         if (roll == 0) newDir = DIR_RIGHT;
330:         else if (roll == 1) newDir = DIR_LEFT;
331:         else if (roll == 2) newDir = DIR_UP;
332:         else newDir = DIR_DOWN;
333: 
334:         if (newDir == currentDirection) {
335:             newDir = (currentDirection == DIR_RIGHT) ? DIR_LEFT : DIR_RIGHT;
336:         }
337:     }
338: 
339:     currentDirection = newDir;
340:     if (newDir == DIR_RIGHT || newDir == DIR_LEFT) {
341:         lastHorizontalDir = newDir;
342:     }
343: 
344:     float rNorm = static_cast<float>(std::rand()) / static_cast<float>(RAND_MAX);
345:     directionSwitchTimer = MIN_SWITCH_TIME + rNorm * (MAX_SWITCH_TIME - MIN_SWITCH_TIME);
346: 
347:     // Switch Biome
348:     EnvironmentTheme nextTheme = static_cast<EnvironmentTheme>((activeTheme + 1) % THEME_COUNT);
349:     setEnvironmentTheme(nextTheme);
350: 
351:     audioMgr.play(SFX_SHIFT);
352:     transitionPhaseTimer = transitionPhaseMax;
353: 
354:     // Check Scene Triggering for Up and Down Directions!
355:     if (currentDirection == DIR_UP) {
356:         enterLadderScene();
357:         return;
358:     } else if (currentDirection == DIR_DOWN) {
359:         enterSkyFallScene();
360:         return;
361:     } else {
362:         if (currentScene != SCENE_PLATFORMER) {
363:             returnToPlatformerScene(true);
364:             return;
365:         }
366:     }
367: 
368:     std::string dirTitle = "";
369:     std::string dirDesc  = "";
370:     glm::vec4 color(0.2f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
371: 
372:     if (currentDirection == DIR_RIGHT) {
373:         dirTitle = "FORWARD RUSH >>>";
374:         dirDesc  = "Sprinting Rightward through new territory!";
375:         color    = glm::vec4(0.1f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
376:     } else if (currentDirection == DIR_LEFT) {
377:         dirTitle = "<<< REVERSE DASH";
378:         dirDesc  = "Direction Inverted! Backtracking Leftward!";
379:         color    = glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.55f, 0.15f, 1.0f);
380:     }
381: 
382:     showCornerNotification(sourceName, dirTitle, dirDesc, color, 1, std::rand() % 4);
383: }

468:     if (!glfwInit()) {

473:     glfwWindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, 3);
474:     glfwWindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, 3);
475:     glfwWindowHint(GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE);
476: 
477:     GLFWwindow* window = glfwCreateWindow(WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, WINDOW_TITLE, nullptr, nullptr);
478:     if (!window) {
479:         std::cerr << "Failed to create GLFW window" << std::endl;
480:         glfwTerminate();
481:         return -1;
482:     }
483: 
484:     glfwMakeContextCurrent(window);
485:     glfwSetFramebufferSizeCallback(window, framebuffer_size_callback);
486:     glfwSwapInterval(1);
487: 
488:     if (!gladLoadGLLoader((GLADloadproc)glfwGetProcAddress)) {
489:         std::cerr << "Failed to initialize GLAD" << std::endl;
490:         return -1;
491:     }
492: 
493:     int initFbW = 0, initFbH = 0;
494:     glfwGetFramebufferSize(window, &initFbW, &initFbH);
495:     glViewport(0, 0, initFbW, initFbH);
496: 
497:     audioMgr.init();
498:     if (!gameRenderer.init()) {
499:         std::cerr << "Failed to initialize Game Renderer" << std::endl;
500:         return -1;
501:     }
502: 
503:     // Load Character Textures (Samurai Mack)
504:     samuraiAnim.texRun    = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Run.png");
505:     samuraiAnim.texIdle   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Idle.png");
506:     samuraiAnim.texJump   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Jump.png");
507:     samuraiAnim.texFall   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Fall.png");
508:     samuraiAnim.texAttack = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Attack1.png");
509:     samuraiAnim.texDeath   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Death.png");
510:     samuraiAnim.texTakeHit = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Take Hit.png");
511:     samuraiAnim.texDefend  = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/samurai/Defend_nobg.png");
512:     samuraiAnim.runFrames     = 8;
513:     samuraiAnim.idleFrames    = 8;
514:     samuraiAnim.jumpFrames    = 2;
515:     samuraiAnim.fallFrames    = 2;
516:     samuraiAnim.attackFrames  = 6;
517:     samuraiAnim.deathFrames   = 6;
518:     samuraiAnim.takeHitFrames = 4;
519:     samuraiAnim.defendFrames  = 8;
520: 
521:     worldTilesetTexture    = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/world_tileset.png");
522:     platformsTexture       = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/platforms.png");
523:     coinTexture            = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/coin.png");
524:     fruitTexture           = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/shield_pickup.png");
525:     heartTexture           = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/heart_pickup.png");
526:     spikesTexture          = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/spikes.png");
527:     birdTexture            = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/bird.png");
528:     directionArrowsTexture = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/direction_arrows.png");
529: 
530:     // Load Enemies Textures
531:     texBodWalk   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_walk.png");
532:     texBodAttack = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_attack.png");
533:     texBodDeath  = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_death.png");
534:     texBodHurt   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_hurt.png");
535:     texBodIdle   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_idle.png");
536:     texBodCast   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_cast.png");
537:     texBodSpell  = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/bod_spell.png");
538: 
539:     texDemonIdle    = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_idle.png");
540:     texDemonWalk    = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_walk.png");
541:     texDemonAttack  = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_attack.png");
542:     texDemonTakeHit = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_take_hit.png");
543:     texDemonDeath   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_death.png");
544:     texDemonSmash   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/demon_smash.png");
545: 
546:     texSlimeIdle      = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/slime_idle.png");
547:     texSlimeMove      = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/slime_move.png");
548:     texSlimeTakeHit   = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/slime_take_hit.png");
549:     texSlimeTransform = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/enemies/slime_transform.png");
550: 
551:     // Load 4 Thematic Background Scenery Textures
552:     texScenery[SCENERY_SILVERGRASS] = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/scenery_silvergrass.png");
553:     texScenery[SCENERY_AUTUMN]      = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/scenery_autumn.png");
554:     texScenery[SCENERY_FOREST]      = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/scenery_forest.png");
555:     texScenery[SCENERY_URBAN]       = gameRenderer.loadTexture("assets/scenery_urban.png");
556: 
557:     // Initialize Celestial Stars for Night Sky
558:     skyStars.clear();
559:     for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
560:         CelestialStar star;
561:         star.x = -16.0f + static_cast<float>(std::rand() % 320) / 10.0f;
562:         star.y = 1.0f + static_cast<float>(std::rand() % 70) / 10.0f;
563:         star.size = 0.08f + static_cast<float>(std::rand() % 14) / 100.0f;
564:         star.twinkleFreq = 1.8f + static_cast<float>(std::rand() % 30) / 10.0f;
565:         star.twinklePhase = static_cast<float>(std::rand() % 628) / 100.0f;
566:         skyStars.push_back(star);
567:     }
568: 
569:     glEnable(GL_BLEND);
570:     glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
571: 
572:     resetGame();
573: 
574:     // Initialize Intro Splash Screen (runs graphically before intro video)
575:     currentGameState = STATE_INTRO_SPLASH;
576:     splashTimer = 0.0f;
577: 
578:     float lastFrameTime = static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime());
579:     float titleUpdateTimer = 0.0f;
580:     int frameCount = 0;
581: 
582:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
583:     // Main Game Loop
584:     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
585:     while (!glfwWindowShouldClose(window))
586:     {
587:         float currentFrameTime = static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime());
588:         float rawDeltaTime = currentFrameTime - lastFrameTime;
589:         lastFrameTime = currentFrameTime;
590: 
591:         if (rawDeltaTime > 0.06f) rawDeltaTime = 0.06f;
592: 
593:         float deltaTime = (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED || showTutorialModal) ? 0.0f : rawDeltaTime;
594:         if (transitionPhaseTimer > 0.0f && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
595:             transitionPhaseTimer -= rawDeltaTime;
596:             if (transitionPhaseTimer > transitionPhaseMax * 0.5f) {
597:                 deltaTime *= 0.5f;
598:             }
599:         }
600:         if (currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) {
601:             deathAnimTimer += rawDeltaTime * 7.0f;
602:         }
603: 
604:         // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
605:         // Day / Night Cycle Simulation (1.5 min = 90.0s per phase, starts at Night)
606:         // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
607:         if (currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
608:             dayNightTimer += deltaTime;
609:             if (shieldTimer > 0.0f) {
610:                 shieldTimer -= deltaTime;
611:                 if (shieldTimer < 0.0f) shieldTimer = 0.0f;
612:             }
613:             if (postHitInvulnTimer > 0.0f) {
614:                 postHitInvulnTimer -= deltaTime;
615:                 if (postHitInvulnTimer < 0.0f) postHitInvulnTimer = 0.0f;
616:             }
617:             if (exitAppearedBannerTimer > 0.0f) {
618:                 exitAppearedBannerTimer -= deltaTime;
619:                 if (exitAppearedBannerTimer < 0.0f) exitAppearedBannerTimer = 0.0f;
620:             }
621:         }
622: 
623:         int cycleIndex = static_cast<int>(dayNightTimer / DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION);
624:         bool isNight = (cycleIndex % 2 == 0); // 0 = Night (initial), 1 = Day, 2 = Night, ...
625:         float phaseTime = std::fmod(dayNightTimer, DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION);
626: 
627:         // 15-second smooth twilight blend between phases
628:         if (isNight) {
629:             if (phaseTime < 75.0f) {
630:                 daylightFactor = 0.0f; // Pure Night
631:             } else {
632:                 float t = (phaseTime - 75.0f) / 15.0f;
633:                 daylightFactor = t; // Dawn transition: 0.0 -> 1.0
634:             }
635:         } else {
636:             if (phaseTime < 75.0f) {
637:                 daylightFactor = 1.0f; // Pure Day
638:             } else {
639:                 float t = (phaseTime - 75.0f) / 15.0f;
640:                 daylightFactor = 1.0f - t; // Dusk transition: 1.0 -> 0.0
641:             }
642:         }
643: 
644:         // Notification on phase switch
645:         if (cycleIndex != lastCycleIndex) {
646:             lastCycleIndex = cycleIndex;
647:             if (isNight) {
648:                 showCornerNotification("CYCLE", "=== NIGHT HAS FALLEN ===", "Moonlight cloaks the landscape! (1.5m cycle)", glm::vec4(0.45f, 0.65f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0);
649:                 spawnFloatingText("=== NIGHT HAS FALLEN (1.5m) ===", (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER ? playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f) : glm::vec2(0.0f, 2.0f)), glm::vec4(0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
650:             } else {
651:                 showCornerNotification("CYCLE", "=== DAYBREAK HAS DAWNED ===", "Warm sunlight illuminates the horizon! (1.5m cycle)", glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.3f, 1.0f), 0);
652:                 spawnFloatingText("=== DAYBREAK HAS DAWNED (1.5m) ===", (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER ? playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f) : glm::vec2(0.0f, 2.0f)), glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.9f, 0.35f, 1.0f));
653:             }
654:         }
655: 
656:         // Environment Atmospheric Interpolation
657:         curSkyColor    = glm::mix(curSkyColor, targetSkyColor, rawDeltaTime * 2.5f);
658:         curPillarColor = glm::mix(curPillarColor, targetPillarColor, rawDeltaTime * 2.5f);
659:         curTileTint    = glm::mix(curTileTint, targetTileTint, rawDeltaTime * 2.5f);
660: 
661:         // Window Title Stats
662:         frameCount++;
663:         titleUpdateTimer += rawDeltaTime;
664:         if (titleUpdateTimer >= 0.25f) {
665:             float fps = frameCount / titleUpdateTimer;
666:             std::string dirStr = (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB) ? "^^^ 3-LADDER CLIMB" :
667:                                  (currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL)     ? "vvv SKY-FALL DIVE" :
668:                                  (currentDirection == DIR_RIGHT)      ? "RIGHT >>>" :
669:                                  (currentDirection == DIR_LEFT)       ? "<<< LEFT"  :
670:                                  (currentDirection == DIR_UP)         ? "^^^ UP" : "vvv DOWN";
671:             std::string zoneStr = (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB) ? "3-LADDER ASCENT" :
672:                                   (currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL)     ? "SKY-FALL DIVE" :
673:                                   (playerPos.y > 4.5f)  ? "SKY CANOPY" :
674:                                   (playerPos.y > 0.5f)  ? "SURFACE PLATFORMS" :
675:                                   (playerPos.y > -2.0f) ? "SURFACE GROUND" : "UNDERGROUND CAVERN";
676:             std::string dashStatus = (dashCooldown <= 0.0f) ? "DASH:READY [SHIFT]" : "DASH:CD";
677:             std::string modeStr = freeExplorationMode ? "MODE:FREE EXPLORE [F]" : "MODE:AUTO-RUN [F]";
678:             std::string stateStr = (currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) ? "GAME OVER: " + gameOverReason + " (SPACE)" :
679:                                    (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED)    ? "PAUSED (ESC / SPACE to Resume)" : "RUNNING";
680:             std::string timePhaseStr = (isNight ? "NIGHT (" : "DAY (") + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION - phaseTime)) + "s)";
681:             std::string sceneryStr = getSceneryName(activeScenery);
682:             std::string title = "The Wenderer | " + sceneryStr + " | " + timePhaseStr +
683:                                 " | Zone: " + zoneStr +
684:                                 " | " + modeStr +
685:                                 " | Dist: " + std::to_string(static_cast<int>(scoreDistance)) +
686:                                 "m | Coins: " + std::to_string(coinsCollected) +
````

````text
1726:                             } else if (enemy.state == ENEMY_STATE_JUMP) {

1768: 
1769:                                             // Horizontal overlap

1771:                                                 enemy.pos.x - 1.0f < tile.pos.x + tileHalfW)

1911:                 // Prune dead/despawned enemies

1935:                     currentAnim = ANIM_IDLE;

1937:                     currentAnim = ANIM_RUN_LEFT;
1938:                 } else {
1939:                     currentAnim = ANIM_RUN_RIGHT;

1942:                 animTimer += deltaTime;

1950:             cameraPos.x = glm::mix(cameraPos.x, gameLadderScene.getPlayerX(), rawDeltaTime * 6.0f);
1951:             cameraPos.y = glm::mix(cameraPos.y, gameLadderScene.getPlayerY() + 1.2f, rawDeltaTime * 5.0f);
1952:         } else if (currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL) {

1954:             cameraPos.y = glm::mix(cameraPos.y, gameSkyFallScene.getPlayerPos().y - 1.2f, rawDeltaTime * 5.0f);
````
