````text
1956:             float lookAhead = (currentDirection == DIR_RIGHT || (isOnLadder && lastHorizontalDir == DIR_RIGHT)) ? 3.0f : -3.0f;
1957:             float targetCamX = playerPos.x + lookAhead;
1958:             float targetCamY = playerPos.y + 0.9f;
1959: 
1960:             cameraPos.x = glm::mix(cameraPos.x, targetCamX, rawDeltaTime * 4.5f);
1961:             cameraPos.y = glm::mix(cameraPos.y, targetCamY, rawDeltaTime * 3.8f);

1964:         // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
1965:         // Render Frame

1967:         // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
1968:         // Render Frame: Calculate Dynamic Celestial Sky Color (1.5m Day/Night Cycle)
1969:         // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
1970:         glm::vec4 nightSkyCol(0.035f, 0.05f, 0.12f, 1.0f);
1971:         glm::vec4 twilightSkyCol(0.38f, 0.16f, 0.20f, 1.0f);
1972:         glm::vec4 daySkyCol(0.24f, 0.52f, 0.85f, 1.0f);
1973: 
1974:         float twilightFactor = 0.0f;
1975:         if (daylightFactor > 0.05f && daylightFactor < 0.95f) {
1976:             twilightFactor = std::sin(daylightFactor * 3.14159f);
1977:         }
1978:         glm::vec4 dynamicSky = glm::mix(nightSkyCol, daySkyCol, daylightFactor);
1979:         dynamicSky = glm::mix(dynamicSky, twilightSkyCol, twilightFactor * 0.70f);
1980: 
1981:         if (currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) {
1982:             glClearColor(0.24f, 0.06f, 0.09f, 1.0f);
1983:         } else if (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB) {
1984:             glClearColor(dynamicSky.r * 0.65f, dynamicSky.g * 0.65f, dynamicSky.b * 0.75f, 1.0f);
1985:         } else if (currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL) {
1986:             glClearColor(dynamicSky.r, dynamicSky.g, dynamicSky.b, 1.0f);
1987:         } else {
1988:             if (playerPos.y < -2.0f) {
1989:                 glClearColor(dynamicSky.r * 0.35f, dynamicSky.g * 0.35f, dynamicSky.b * 0.42f, 1.0f);
1990:             } else {
1991:                 glClearColor(dynamicSky.r, dynamicSky.g, dynamicSky.b, 1.0f);
1992:             }

1994:         glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

1996:         glUseProgram(gameRenderer.getProgram());

1998:         float aspect = static_cast<float>(WINDOW_WIDTH) / static_cast<float>(WINDOW_HEIGHT);
1999:         float halfH  = 6.8f;
2000:         float halfW  = halfH * aspect;
2001:         glm::mat4 projection = glm::ortho(-halfW, halfW, -halfH, halfH, -1.0f, 1.0f);
2002:         glm::mat4 view = glm::translate(glm::mat4(1.0f), glm::vec3(-cameraPos.x, -cameraPos.y, 0.0f));
2003: 
2004:         if (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB)
2005:         {
````

````text
2459:                 modelSpell = glm::scale(modelSpell, glm::vec3(3.5f, 4.5f, 1.0f));
2460:                 gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelSpell, view, projection, glm::vec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.95f), (texBodSpell != 0), sUV, texBodSpell);
2461:             }
2462: 
2463:             // 8d. Render Overhead Enemy Health Bars
2464:             UIManager::instance().renderEnemyHealthBars(view, projection, gameWorld.enemies, animTimer);
2465:         }
2466: 
2467:         // 8b. Render World-Space Floating Texts (Pickups, Direction Warps, Score Popups)
2468:         UIManager::instance().renderFloatingTexts(view, projection);
2469: 
2470:         // 9. Transition Phase Energy Flash
2471:         if (transitionPhaseTimer > 0.0f) {
2472:             float progress = transitionPhaseTimer / transitionPhaseMax;
2473:             float flashAlpha = std::sin(progress * 3.14159f) * 0.22f;
2474:             glm::mat4 identityView = glm::mat4(1.0f);
2475:             glm::mat4 orthoUI = glm::ortho(-halfW, halfW, -halfH, halfH, -1.0f, 1.0f);
2476: 
2477:             glm::mat4 modelFlash = glm::mat4(1.0f);
2478:             modelFlash = glm::scale(modelFlash, glm::vec3(halfW * 2.0f, halfH * 2.0f, 1.0f));
2479:             gameRenderer.drawQuad(modelFlash, identityView, orthoUI, glm::vec4(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, flashAlpha), false, glm::vec4(0), 0);
2480:         }
2481: 
2482:         // 10. Comprehensible Corner HUD Card
2483:         UIManager::instance().renderCornerNotification(halfW, halfH, frameCount, coinTexture, fruitTexture);
2484: 
2485:         // 11. Top-Right On-Screen Score Counter HUD
2486:         int totalScore = static_cast<int>(scoreDistance) * 10 + coinsCollected * 50 + relicsTriggered * 100;
2487:         UIManager::instance().renderScoreHUD(halfW, halfH, totalScore, coinsCollected, scoreDistance, shieldTimer, playerLives, frameCount, coinTexture, heartTexture, isBlocking, blockCooldown);
2488: 
2489:         // On-Screen Start Hint Banner (when standing still in idle animation at game start)
2490:         if (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER && isGameIdleAtStart && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2491:             UIManager::instance().renderStartHintBanner(halfW, halfH, animTimer);
2492:         }
2493: 
2494:         // Top-Center Mini-Game Scene Countdown & Exit Banner HUD
2495:         if ((currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB || currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL) && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2496:             float trialTimeLeft = std::max(0.0f, SCENE_DIRECTION_COOLDOWN - scenePlayTime);
2497:             UIManager::instance().renderTrialBadge(halfW, halfH, trialTimeLeft, SCENE_DIRECTION_COOLDOWN, static_cast<float>(glfwGetTime()));
2498:         }
2499: 
2500:         // 12. Pause Menu Modal Dialog (ESC Key)
2501:         if (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED) {
2502:             UIManager::instance().renderPauseMenu(halfW, halfH, totalScore, coinsCollected, relicsTriggered,
2503:                                                   scoreDistance, freeExplorationMode, static_cast<int>(activeScenery),
2504:                                                   isNight, DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION - phaseTime, autoShiftEnabled,
2505:                                                   audioMgr.isMuted());
2506:         }
2507: 
2508:         // 13. Game Over Screen
2509:         if (currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) {
2510:             UIManager::instance().renderGameOver(halfW, halfH, gameOverReason, totalScore, coinsCollected, scoreDistance);
2511:         }
2512: 
2513:         // 14. Tutorial Window Modal Dialog (Shown once after Intro & via [T] in Pause Menu)
2514:         if (showTutorialModal) {
2515:             UIManager::instance().renderTutorialModal(halfW, halfH, tutorialOpenedFromPause);
2516:         }
2517: 
2518:         glfwSwapBuffers(window);
2519:         glfwPollEvents();
2520:     }
2521: 
2522:     // Cleanup Resources
2523:     introVideoPlayer.close();
2524:     audioMgr.stopBGM();
2525:     gameRenderer.cleanup();
2526:     if (samuraiAnim.texRun) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texRun);
2527:     if (samuraiAnim.texIdle) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texIdle);
2528:     if (samuraiAnim.texJump) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texJump);
2529:     if (samuraiAnim.texFall) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texFall);
2530:     if (samuraiAnim.texAttack) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texAttack);
2531:     if (samuraiAnim.texDeath) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texDeath);
2532:     if (samuraiAnim.texTakeHit) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texTakeHit);
2533:     if (samuraiAnim.texDefend) glDeleteTextures(1, &samuraiAnim.texDefend);
2534: 
2535:     if (worldTilesetTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &worldTilesetTexture);
2536:     if (platformsTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &platformsTexture);
2537:     if (coinTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &coinTexture);
2538:     if (fruitTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &fruitTexture);
2539:     if (heartTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &heartTexture);
2540:     if (spikesTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &spikesTexture);
2541:     if (birdTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &birdTexture);
2542:     if (directionArrowsTexture) glDeleteTextures(1, &directionArrowsTexture);
2543:     for (int s = 0; s < SCENERY_COUNT; ++s) {
2544:         if (texScenery[s]) glDeleteTextures(1, &texScenery[s]);
2545:     }
2546:     if (texBodWalk) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodWalk);
2547:     if (texBodAttack) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodAttack);
2548:     if (texBodDeath) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodDeath);
2549:     if (texBodHurt) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodHurt);
2550:     if (texBodIdle) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodIdle);
2551:     if (texBodCast) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodCast);
2552:     if (texBodSpell) glDeleteTextures(1, &texBodSpell);
2553:     if (texDemonIdle) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonIdle);
2554:     if (texDemonWalk) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonWalk);
2555:     if (texDemonAttack) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonAttack);
2556:     if (texDemonTakeHit) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonTakeHit);
2557:     if (texDemonDeath) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonDeath);
2558:     if (texDemonSmash) glDeleteTextures(1, &texDemonSmash);
2559:     if (texSlimeIdle) glDeleteTextures(1, &texSlimeIdle);
2560:     if (texSlimeMove) glDeleteTextures(1, &texSlimeMove);
2561:     if (texSlimeTakeHit) glDeleteTextures(1, &texSlimeTakeHit);
2562:     if (texSlimeTransform) glDeleteTextures(1, &texSlimeTransform);
2563: 
2564:     glfwDestroyWindow(window);
2565:     glfwTerminate();
2566:     return 0;
2567: }

2569: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
2570: // Process User Input with Pause Menu & Direction Interrupts
2571: // -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
2572: void processInput(GLFWwindow* window, float deltaTime)
2573: {
2574:     (void)deltaTime;
2575:     static bool escPressedLast = false;
2576:     static bool rKeyLast = false;
2577: 
2578:     // Handle Tutorial Window Dismissal
2579:     if (showTutorialModal) {
2580:         bool dismissPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2581:                                glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ENTER) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2582:                                glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2583:                                glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_T) == GLFW_PRESS);
2584:         if (dismissPressed && !tutDismissLast) {
2585:             showTutorialModal = false;
2586:             tutDismissLast = true;
2587:             if (!tutorialOpenedFromPause) {
2588:                 currentGameState = STATE_RUNNING;
2589:                 isGameIdleAtStart = true;
2590:                 playerVel = glm::vec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
2591:             }
2592:             return; // Modal captures input exclusively and prevents dismiss key bleed-through!
2593:         }
2594:         tutDismissLast = dismissPressed;
2595:         return; // Modal captures input exclusively
2596:     }
2597:     tutDismissLast = false;
2598: 
2599:     // Intro Splash Screen Input: Press Space, Enter, or Esc to advance to Intro Video
2600:     static bool splashSkipLast = false;
2601:     static bool videoSkipLast  = false;
2602:     if (currentGameState == STATE_INTRO_SPLASH) {
2603:         bool skipPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2604:                             glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ENTER) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2605:                             glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) == GLFW_PRESS);
2606:         if (skipPressed && !splashSkipLast) {
2607:             startIntroVideo();
2608:             videoSkipLast = true; // Key held to skip splash cannot dismiss or skip video!
2609:             splashSkipLast = true;
2610:             return;
2611:         }
2612:         splashSkipLast = skipPressed;
2613:         return;
2614:     }
2615:     splashSkipLast = false;
2616: 
2617:     // Intro Video Input: Press Space, Enter, or Esc to skip intro
2618:     if (currentGameState == STATE_INTRO_VIDEO) {
2619:         bool skipPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2620:                             glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ENTER) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2621:                             glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) == GLFW_PRESS);
2622:         if (skipPressed && !videoSkipLast) {
2623:             introVideoPlayer.skip();
2624:             introVideoPlayer.close();
2625:             currentGameState = STATE_RUNNING;
2626:             isGameIdleAtStart = true;
2627:             playerVel = glm::vec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
2628:             if (!hasShownInitialTutorial) {
2629:                 showTutorialModal = true;
2630:                 hasShownInitialTutorial = true;
2631:                 tutorialOpenedFromPause = false;
2632:                 tutDismissLast = true; // Key held to skip video cannot dismiss tutorial
2633:             }
2634:             audioMgr.startBGM();
2635:             videoSkipLast = true;
2636:             return;
2637:         }
2638:         videoSkipLast = skipPressed;
2639:         return;
2640:     }
2641:     videoSkipLast = false;
2642: 
2643:     // ESC Key Toggle Pause
2644:     bool escPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ESCAPE) == GLFW_PRESS);
2645:     if (escPressed && !escPressedLast) {
2646:         if (currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2647:             currentGameState = STATE_PAUSED;
2648:         } else if (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED) {
2649:             currentGameState = STATE_RUNNING;
2650:         }
2651:     }
2652:     escPressedLast = escPressed;
2653: 
2654:     // Restart Key (R key)
2655:     bool rKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_R) == GLFW_PRESS);
2656:     if (rKeyPressed && !rKeyLast) {
2657:         if (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED || currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) {
2658:             resetGame();
2659:         }
2660:     }
2661:     rKeyLast = rKeyPressed;
2662: 
2663:     // Tutorial Window Toggle Key (T key - dedicated, opens tutorial from either Pause Menu or Running state)
2664:     static bool tKeyLast = false;
2665:     bool tKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_T) == GLFW_PRESS);
2666:     if (tKeyPressed && !tKeyLast) {
2667:         showTutorialModal = true;
2668:         tutorialOpenedFromPause = (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED);
2669:         tutDismissLast = true; // Key held: prevents the modal from instantly dismissing on next frame!
2670:     }
2671:     tKeyLast = tKeyPressed;
2672: 
2673:     // Shift Mode Toggle Key (Y key - toggles autonomous timer-based direction shifts)
2674:     static bool yKeyLast = false;
2675:     bool yKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_Y) == GLFW_PRESS);
2676:     if (yKeyPressed && !yKeyLast) {
2677:         autoShiftEnabled = !autoShiftEnabled;
2678:         showCornerNotification("SHIFT MODE", autoShiftEnabled ? "AUTO SHIFTS ON" : "AUTO SHIFTS OFF",
2679:                                autoShiftEnabled ? "Timer shifts enabled (every 6.5s)" : "Direction shifts via Direction Relics only!",
2680:                                autoShiftEnabled ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.65f, 0.2f, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(0.35f, 0.95f, 0.45f, 1.0f), 1, 0);
2681:     }
2682:     yKeyLast = yKeyPressed;
2683: 
2684:     // Cycle Scenery Theme (B key): Silvergrass -> Autumn -> Forest -> Urban
2685:     static bool bKeyLast = false;
2686:     bool bKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_B) == GLFW_PRESS);
2687:     if (bKeyPressed && !bKeyLast) {
2688:         setSceneryTheme(static_cast<SceneryTheme>((activeScenery + 1) % SCENERY_COUNT));
2689:     }
2690:     bKeyLast = bKeyPressed;
2691: 
2692:     // Advance Day/Night Cycle (N key) - Instant half-cycle fast-forward
2693:     static bool nKeyLast = false;
2694:     bool nKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_N) == GLFW_PRESS);
2695:     if (nKeyPressed && !nKeyLast) {
2696:         dayNightTimer += DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION;
2697:         int newIdx = static_cast<int>(dayNightTimer / DAY_NIGHT_CYCLE_DURATION);
2698:         bool nowNight = (newIdx % 2 == 0);
2699:         showCornerNotification("CYCLE", nowNight ? "TOGGLED: NIGHT TIME" : "TOGGLED: DAY TIME",
2700:                                nowNight ? "Moonlight blankets the landscape" : "Sunlight bathes the scenery",
2701:                                nowNight ? glm::vec4(0.45f, 0.65f, 1.0f, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.3f, 1.0f), 0);
2702:         spawnFloatingText(nowNight ? "=== NIGHT TIME ===" : "=== DAY TIME ===",
2703:                           (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER ? playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f) : glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f)),
2704:                           nowNight ? glm::vec4(0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.9f, 0.35f, 1.0f));
2705:     }
2706:     nKeyLast = nKeyPressed;
2707: 
2708:     // Toggle Free Exploration Mode (F key) - Pauses auto-sprint and allows manual A/D platform exploration
2709:     static bool fKeyLast = false;
2710:     bool fKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_F) == GLFW_PRESS);
2711:     if (fKeyPressed && !fKeyLast && (currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING || currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED)) {
2712:         freeExplorationMode = !freeExplorationMode;
2713:         if (freeExplorationMode) {
2714:             isGameIdleAtStart = false;
2715:             if (!isSliding && !isDashing) {
2716:                 playerVel.x = 0.0f;
2717:             }
2718:             audioMgr.play(SFX_SHIFT);
2719:             showCornerNotification("EXPLORATION", "FREE EXPLORE: ON",
2720:                                    "Auto-run paused! Full manual A/D movement control.",
2721:                                    glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.55f, 1.0f), 0);
2722:             spawnFloatingText("FREE EXPLORATION [ON]", playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.6f), glm::vec4(0.35f, 1.0f, 0.6f, 1.0f));
2723:         } else {
2724:             float dirSign = (lastHorizontalDir == DIR_LEFT) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
2725:             currentDirection = lastHorizontalDir;
2726:             if (!isSliding && !isDashing && !isOnLadder) {
2727:                 playerVel.x = dirSign * playerSpeed;
2728:             }
2729:             audioMgr.play(SFX_SHIFT);
2730:             showCornerNotification("RUNNER MODE", "AUTO-RUN: RESUMED",
2731:                                    "Continuous platform sprint active! [F to Toggle]",
2732:                                    glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0);
2733:             spawnFloatingText("AUTO-RUNNER [ON]", playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.6f), glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
2734:         }
2735:     }
2736:     fKeyLast = fKeyPressed;
2737: 
2738:     // Toggle Music Mute (M key) - Toggles background music mute on/off
2739:     static bool mKeyLast = false;
2740:     bool mKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_M) == GLFW_PRESS);
2741:     if (mKeyPressed && !mKeyLast) {
2742:         audioMgr.toggleBgmMute();
2743:         bool muted = audioMgr.isMuted();
2744:         showCornerNotification("MUSIC", muted ? "BGM: MUTED" : "BGM: 50% VOLUME",
2745:                                muted ? "Background music muted [Press M to Unmute]" : "Background music playing at 50% [Quarter in the Slot]",
2746:                                muted ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.4f, 0.4f, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(0.4f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0);
2747:         spawnFloatingText(muted ? "MUSIC: MUTED" : "MUSIC: UNMUTED (50%)",
2748:                           (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER ? playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f) : glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.5f)),
2749:                           muted ? glm::vec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.45f, 1.0f) : glm::vec4(0.45f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
2750:     }
2751:     mKeyLast = mKeyPressed;
2752: 
2753:     // If Paused:
2754:     if (currentGameState == STATE_PAUSED) {
2755:         if (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS || glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ENTER) == GLFW_PRESS) {
2756:             currentGameState = STATE_RUNNING;
2757:         }
2758:         if (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_Q) == GLFW_PRESS) {
2759:             glfwSetWindowShouldClose(window, true);
2760:         }
2761:         return;
2762:     }
2763: 
2764:     static bool gameOverRestartLast = false;
2765:     if (currentGameState == STATE_GAME_OVER) {
2766:         bool restartPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2767:                                glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_ENTER) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2768:                                glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_R) == GLFW_PRESS);
2769:         if (restartPressed && !gameOverRestartLast) {
2770:             resetGame();
2771:             gameOverRestartLast = true;
2772:             return; // Immediately return so Space doesn't jump or start movement!
2773:         }
2774:         gameOverRestartLast = restartPressed;
2775:         if (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_Q) == GLFW_PRESS) {
2776:             glfwSetWindowShouldClose(window, true);
2777:         }
2778:         return;
2779:     }
2780:     gameOverRestartLast = false;
2781: 
2782:     // DASH Input (Left or Right Shift)
2783:     bool shiftPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_LEFT_SHIFT) == GLFW_PRESS || glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_RIGHT_SHIFT) == GLFW_PRESS);
2784:     if (shiftPressed && !isDashing && dashCooldown <= 0.0f && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2785:         isDashing = true;
2786:         dashTimer = DASH_BURST_TIME;
2787:         dashCooldown = DASH_COOLDOWN_TIME;
2788:         audioMgr.play(SFX_SLIDE);
2789: 
2790:         if (currentScene == SCENE_PLATFORMER) {
2791:             float dirSign = (lastHorizontalDir == DIR_LEFT) ? -1.0f : 1.0f;
2792:             playerVel.x = dirSign * DASH_SPEED_MAG;
2793:             spawnFloatingText(">> SHADOW DASH >>", playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.0f), glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
2794:         } else if (currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL) {
2795:             float steerSign = (gameSkyFallScene.getVelX() >= 0.0f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
2796:             gameSkyFallScene.applyDash(steerSign * DASH_SPEED_MAG);
2797:             spawnFloatingText(">> SKY DASH >>", gameSkyFallScene.getPlayerPos() + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.0f), glm::vec4(0.2f, 0.9f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
2798:         } else if (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB) {
2799:             gameLadderScene.applyDash(2.2f);
2800:             spawnFloatingText(">> LADDER SURGE >>", glm::vec2(gameLadderScene.getPlayerX(), gameLadderScene.getPlayerY() + 1.0f), glm::vec4(0.3f, 1.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f));
2801:         }
2802:         showCornerNotification("SKILL", "SHADOW DASH", "Burst speed & trap invulnerability!", glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0);
2803:     }
2804: 
2805:     // ATTACK Input (J key, X key, or Left Mouse Button)
2806:     static bool attackKeyLast = false;
2807:     bool attackKeyPressed = (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_J) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2808:                              glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_X) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2809:                              glfwGetMouseButton(window, GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) == GLFW_PRESS);
2810:     if (attackKeyPressed && !attackKeyLast && !isAttacking && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2811:         isAttacking = true;
2812:         attackAnimTimer = 0.0f;
2813:         attackDamageDealt = false;
2814:         audioMgr.play(SFX_SLASH);
2815:     }
2816:     attackKeyLast = attackKeyPressed;
2817: 
2818:     // DEFEND / BLOCK Input (Right Mouse Button or K key)
2819:     static bool defendKeyLast = false;
2820:     bool defendKeyPressed = (glfwGetMouseButton(window, GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2821:                              glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_K) == GLFW_PRESS);
2822:     if (defendKeyPressed && !defendKeyLast && !isBlocking && !isAttacking && blockCooldown <= 0.0f && currentGameState == STATE_RUNNING) {
2823:         isBlocking = true;
2824:         blockTimer = 0.0f;
2825:         spawnFloatingText("[ DEFENDING ]", playerPos + glm::vec2(0.0f, 1.4f),
2826:                           glm::vec4(0.4f, 0.85f, 1.0f, 1.0f), 0.22f, 0.32f, 0.8f, 0.8f);
2827:     }
2828:     defendKeyLast = defendKeyPressed;
2829: 
2830:     // Scene-Specific Controls handled directly by LadderScene and SkyFallScene updates
2831:     if (currentScene == SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB || currentScene == SCENE_SKY_FALL) {
2832:         return;
2833:     }
2834: 
2835:     // Jump Input: From ground, mid-slope slide, or mid-ladder!
2836:     if ((isGrounded || isSliding || isOnLadder) &&
2837:         (glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_SPACE) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2838:          glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_W) == GLFW_PRESS ||
2839:          glfwGetKey(window, GLFW_KEY_UP) == GLFW_PRESS))
2840:     {
2841:         if (isGameIdleAtStart) {
2842:             // Jump straight up in place while staying idle until player chooses horizontal movement!
2843:             playerVel.y = JUMP_BURST;
2844:             playerVel.x = 0.0f;
2845:             isGrounded = false;
````

````text
681: void World::ensureGroundAround(float targetX, EnvironmentTheme theme) {
682:     // Generate chunks to cover [targetX - 45, targetX + 45]
683:     while (targetX - 45.0f < leftGenEdge) {
684:         generateChunk(leftGenEdge - 35.0f, leftGenEdge, false, theme);
685:         leftGenEdge -= 35.0f;
686:     }
687:     while (targetX + 45.0f > rightGenEdge) {
688:         generateChunk(rightGenEdge, rightGenEdge + 35.0f, false, theme);
689:         rightGenEdge += 35.0f;
690:     }
691: 
692:     // Verify solid platforms exist within immediate vicinity of targetX
693:     bool hasLocalPlatform = false;
694:     for (const auto& t : tiles) {
695:         if (!t.isLadder && std::abs(t.pos.x - targetX) < 8.0f) {
696:             hasLocalPlatform = true;
697:             break;
698:         }
699:     }
700:     if (!hasLocalPlatform) {
701:         generateChunk(targetX - 45.0f, targetX + 45.0f, false, theme);
702:         leftGenEdge = std::min(leftGenEdge, targetX - 45.0f);
703:         rightGenEdge = std::max(rightGenEdge, targetX + 45.0f);
704:     }
705: }
````

````text
18: out vec2 TexCoord;

20: uniform mat4 uMVP;

23: void main()
24: {
25:     gl_Position = uMVP * vec4(aPos, 1.0);
26:     TexCoord = vec2(uUVRect.x + aTexCoord.x * uUVRect.z,
27:                     uUVRect.y + aTexCoord.y * uUVRect.w);
28: }

30: 
31: const char *fragmentShaderSource = R"(
32: #version 330 core
33: out vec4 FragColor;
34: 
35: in vec2 TexCoord;
36: 
37: uniform sampler2D uTexture;
38: uniform vec4 uColor;
39: uniform bool uUseTexture;
40: uniform bool uDiscardAlpha;
41: uniform bool uIsCircle;
42: uniform float uRimPower;
43: 
44: void main()
45: {
46:     if (uIsCircle) {
47:         vec2 p = TexCoord - vec2(0.5);
48:         float dist = length(p);
49:         if (dist > 0.5) discard;
50: 
51:         // Anti-aliased outer boundary edge
52:         float edge = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.482, 0.50, dist);
53: 
54:         // Glowing force-field outer rim
55:         float rim = smoothstep(0.32, 0.49, dist);
56:         rim = pow(rim, max(0.2, uRimPower * 0.5));
57: 
58:         // Translucent inner energy core
59:         float core = smoothstep(0.50, 0.0, dist) * 0.22;
60: 
61:         float alpha = (core + rim * 0.85) * edge * uColor.a;
62:         // Brighter electric cyan/white highlight on the energy rim
63:         vec3 col = mix(uColor.rgb, vec3(0.85, 0.96, 1.0), rim * 0.75);
64:         FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);
65:     } else if (uUseTexture) {
66:         vec4 texColor = texture(uTexture, TexCoord);
67:         if (uDiscardAlpha && texColor.a < 0.12) discard;
68:         FragColor = texColor * uColor;
69:     } else {
70:         FragColor = uColor;
71:     }
72: }
73: )";

113:         int pixelY = startY + py;
114:         int idx = (pixelY * FONT_TEX_W + pixelX) * 4;
115:         if (bitSet) {

117:           fontPixels[idx + 1] = 255;
118:           fontPixels[idx + 2] = 255;

122:           fontPixels[idx + 1] = 0;
123:           fontPixels[idx + 2] = 0;

170: unsigned int Renderer::loadTexture(const char *filepath, bool linear) {
171:   int width, height, nrChannels;
172:   unsigned char *data = stbi_load(filepath, &width, &height, &nrChannels, 4);
173:   if (!data) {
174:     std::cerr << "Failed to load texture file: " << filepath << std::endl;
175:     return 0;
176:   }
177: 
178:   unsigned int textureID;
179:   glGenTextures(1, &textureID);
180:   glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, textureID);
181: 
182:   glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
183:   glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
184:   glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,
185:                   linear ? GL_LINEAR : GL_NEAREST);
186:   glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,
187:                   linear ? GL_LINEAR : GL_NEAREST);
188: 
189:   glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA, width, height, 0, GL_RGBA,
190:                GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, data);
191:   stbi_image_free(data);
192: 
193:   return textureID;
194: }

196: void Renderer::drawQuad(const glm::mat4 &model, const glm::mat4 &view,
197:                         const glm::mat4 &projection, const glm::vec4 &color,
198:                         bool useTexture, const glm::vec4 &uvRect,
199:                         unsigned int textureID, bool discardAlpha) {
200:   glUseProgram(shaderProgram);
201:   glm::mat4 mvp = projection * view * model;
202:   glUniformMatrix4fv(uMVPLoc, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(mvp));
203:   glUniform4fv(uColorLoc, 1, glm::value_ptr(color));
204:   glUniform1i(uUseTextureLoc, useTexture ? 1 : 0);
205:   glUniform1i(uDiscardAlphaLoc, discardAlpha ? 1 : 0);
206:   if (uIsCircleLoc != -1)
207:     glUniform1i(uIsCircleLoc, 0);
208:   glUniform4fv(uUVRectLoc, 1, glm::value_ptr(uvRect));
209: 
210:   if (useTexture && textureID != 0) {
211:     glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, textureID);
212:   }
213: 
214:   glBindVertexArray(quadVAO);
215:   glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 6);
216:   glBindVertexArray(0);
217: }
218: 
219: void Renderer::drawCircle(const glm::mat4 &model, const glm::mat4 &view,
220:                           const glm::mat4 &projection, const glm::vec4 &color,
221:                           float rimPower) {
222:   glUseProgram(shaderProgram);
223:   glm::mat4 mvp = projection * view * model;
224:   glUniformMatrix4fv(uMVPLoc, 1, GL_FALSE, glm::value_ptr(mvp));
225:   glUniform4fv(uColorLoc, 1, glm::value_ptr(color));
226:   glUniform1i(uUseTextureLoc, 0);
227:   glUniform1i(uDiscardAlphaLoc, 0);
228:   if (uIsCircleLoc != -1)
229:     glUniform1i(uIsCircleLoc, 1);
230:   if (uRimPowerLoc != -1)
231:     glUniform1f(uRimPowerLoc, rimPower);
232:   glUniform4f(uUVRectLoc, 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
233: 
234:   glBindVertexArray(quadVAO);
235:   glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 6);
236:   glBindVertexArray(0);
237: 
238:   if (uIsCircleLoc != -1)
239:     glUniform1i(uIsCircleLoc, 0);
240: }
241: 
242: unsigned int Renderer::compileShaders(const char *vSource,
243:                                       const char *fSource) {
244:   int success;
245:   char infoLog[512];
246: 
247:   unsigned int vertexShader = glCreateShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER);
248:   glShaderSource(vertexShader, 1, &vSource, nullptr);
249:   glCompileShader(vertexShader);
250:   glGetShaderiv(vertexShader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &success);
251:   if (!success) {
252:     glGetShaderInfoLog(vertexShader, 512, nullptr, infoLog);
253:     std::cerr << "ERROR::SHADER::VERTEX::COMPILATION_FAILED\n"
254:               << infoLog << std::endl;
255:     return 0;
256:   }
257: 
258:   unsigned int fragmentShader = glCreateShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER);
259:   glShaderSource(fragmentShader, 1, &fSource, nullptr);
260:   glCompileShader(fragmentShader);
261:   glGetShaderiv(fragmentShader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &success);
262:   if (!success) {
263:     glGetShaderInfoLog(fragmentShader, 512, nullptr, infoLog);
264:     std::cerr << "ERROR::SHADER::FRAGMENT::COMPILATION_FAILED\n"
265:               << infoLog << std::endl;
266:     glDeleteShader(vertexShader);
267:     return 0;
268:   }
269: 
270:   unsigned int program = glCreateProgram();
271:   glAttachShader(program, vertexShader);
272:   glAttachShader(program, fragmentShader);
273:   glLinkProgram(program);
274:   glGetProgramiv(program, GL_LINK_STATUS, &success);
275:   if (!success) {
276:     glGetProgramInfoLog(program, 512, nullptr, infoLog);
277:     std::cerr << "ERROR::SHADER::PROGRAM::LINKING_FAILED\n"
278:               << infoLog << std::endl;
279:     glDeleteShader(vertexShader);
280:     glDeleteShader(fragmentShader);
281:     return 0;
282:   }
283: 
284:   glDeleteShader(vertexShader);
285:   glDeleteShader(fragmentShader);
286:   return program;
287: }
288: 
289: void Renderer::drawText(const std::string &text, float startX, float startY,
290:                         float charWidth, float charHeight,
291:                         const glm::vec4 &color, const glm::mat4 &projection,
292:                         const glm::mat4 &view) {
293:   float curX = startX;
294:   float curY = startY;
295: 
296:   for (char c : text) {
297:     if (c == '\n') {
298:       curY -= charHeight * 1.35f;
299:       curX = startX;
300:       continue;
301:     }
302: 
303:     unsigned char uc = static_cast<unsigned char>(c);
304:     if (uc >= 128)
305:       uc = '?';
306: 
307:     int glyphCol = uc % 16;
308:     int glyphRow = uc / 16;
309: 
310:     float u = static_cast<float>(glyphCol * 8) / 128.0f;
311:     float v = static_cast<float>(glyphRow * 8) / 64.0f;
312:     float du = 8.0f / 128.0f;
313:     float dv = 8.0f / 64.0f;
314: 
315:     glm::mat4 model = glm::mat4(1.0f);
316:     model = glm::translate(model, glm::vec3(curX + charWidth * 0.5f,
317:                                             curY + charHeight * 0.5f, 0.0f));
318:     model = glm::scale(model, glm::vec3(charWidth, charHeight, 1.0f));
319: 
320:     drawQuad(model, view, projection, color, true, glm::vec4(u, v, du, dv),
321:              fontTextureID);
322: 
323:     curX += charWidth;
324:   }
325: }
326: 
327: void Renderer::cleanup() {
328:   if (quadVAO)
329:     glDeleteVertexArrays(1, &quadVAO);
330:   if (quadVBO)
331:     glDeleteBuffers(1, &quadVBO);
332:   if (shaderProgram)
333:     glDeleteProgram(shaderProgram);
334:   if (fontTextureID)
335:     glDeleteTextures(1, &fontTextureID);
336: }
````

````text
27: 
28: ## 🎮 About The Project
29: 
30: **The Wenderer** is a 2D side-view endless runner and platformer built in **C++** using **Modern OpenGL (3.3 Core Profile)**. 
31: 
32: Unlike traditional static runners, **The Wenderer** features autonomous dynamic direction changes (suddenly flipping between running right, left, and climbing ladders) in random intervals, paired with a smoothly reframing side-view camera, animated character sprites (running, climbing, falling, jumping), procedural platforms, ladders, spikes, barriers, and collectible gems.
33: 
34: ---
35: 
36: ## 🚀 Quick Start (Build & Run)
37: 
38: ### Requirements
39: - MinGW-w64 (`g++` supporting C++17) or CMake
40: - All OpenGL and imaging libraries (`GLFW`, `GLAD`, `GLM`, `stb_image`) are bundled in the repo!
41: 
42: ### Building with Make (Recommended)
43: 
44: Depending on your environment (MSYS2, Git Bash, or standalone MinGW), the GNU make executable is named `make` or `mingw32-make`:
45: 
46: ```bash
47: # Build the project (creates ./build/ and compiles main.exe)
48: make
49: # (or: mingw32-make)
50: 
51: # Run the game:
52: # In PowerShell / Bash:
53: ./build/main.exe
54: # In Windows Command Prompt (cmd.exe):
55: build\main.exe
56: 
57: # Or compile and launch immediately in one step:
58: make win
59: # (or: mingw32-make win)
60: 
61: # Package standalone portable game distribution zip:
62: make package
63: # (or: mingw32-make package)
64: ```
65: 
66: ### Direct Compilation with g++ (No Make required)
67: 
68: If `make` is not available, you can compile directly. Note that `./build/` must exist and include the runtime DLLs:
69: 
70: **In PowerShell:**
71: ```powershell
72: if (!(Test-Path "build")) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "build" | Out-Null }; Copy-Item lib/*.dll build/ -Force
73: g++.exe -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -O2 -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -I./include ./src/main.cpp ./src/VideoPlayer.cpp ./src/Audio.cpp ./src/Renderer.cpp ./src/World.cpp ./src/UIManager.cpp ./src/LadderScene.cpp ./src/SkyFallScene.cpp ./src/glad.c -o ./build/main.exe -L./lib -lglfw3 -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -lmfplat -lmfreadwrite -lmfuuid -lole32
74: ./build/main.exe
75: ```
76: 
77: **In Windows Command Prompt (cmd.exe):**
78: ```cmd
79: if not exist build mkdir build
80: copy /y lib\*.dll build\
81: g++.exe -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -O2 -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -I./include ./src/main.cpp ./src/VideoPlayer.cpp ./src/Audio.cpp ./src/Renderer.cpp ./src/World.cpp ./src/UIManager.cpp ./src/LadderScene.cpp ./src/SkyFallScene.cpp ./src/glad.c -o ./build/main.exe -L./lib -lglfw3 -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm -lmfplat -lmfreadwrite -lmfuuid -lole32
82: build\main.exe
83: ```
84: 
85: ### Controls
86: - **`A` / `D` (or Left / Right Arrow)**: **Walk & Run (Free Exploration - DEFAULT)** — Explore the world at your own pace! Samurai Mack stands still in idle stance when keys are released.
87: - **`F`**: **Toggle Auto-Runner Mode** — Switches between default manual Free Exploration and continuous autonomous sprinting platformer mode.
88: - **`M`**: **Mute / Unmute Background Music** — Toggles looping background music (`Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`, default 50% volume) with real-time HUD notification.
89: - **`J` / `X` / `Left Mouse Click`**: **Sword Slash Attack** — Swing katana to defeat Bringer of Death (1 hit), Initial Slime (2 hits), and Demon Slime Boss (5 hits)!
90: - **`Right Mouse Click` / `K`**: **Defend / Parry Stance** — Raise katana in defensive guard for up to 1.0s using `Defend_nobg.png`! Absorbs all enemy attacks (Slime, Bringer of Death scythe, Thunder cloud spell, Demon Boss cleave/smash) with a resonant metallic parry clang (`SFX_BLOCK`), floating `[PARRY]` text, and 0.6s grace invulnerability (2.0s cooldown on deflection).
91: - **`Space` / `Esc` / `Enter` (During Intro Splash & Video)**: **Skip Intro Screen & Video** — Instantly advance from the academic course/group intro splash screen or skip the cinematic video directly into gameplay.
92: - **`Left Shift`**: **Dash Movement** — High-speed burst with ghost trail afterimages and spike/hazard invulnerability!
93: - **`Space` / `W` / `Up Arrow`**: Jump across gaps and over spiky traps, or latch on and climb upward inside ladder shafts
94: - **`S` / `Down Arrow`**: Drop down through one-way platforms or descend into underground ladder shafts
95: - **`Esc`**: Open / Close **Pause Menu** (pause physics simulation, inspect stats, restart, or quit)
96: - **`B`**: **Cycle Background Scenery** (Silvergrass Field <-> Autumn Foliage <-> Green Forest Foliage <-> Urban Area)
97: - **`N`**: **Fast-Forward Day / Night Cycle** (Instantly advance 90-second half-cycle between Day and Night)
98: - **`T`**: **Open Tutorial Window** — View the comprehensive How-to-Play guide modal dialog during active exploration or inside the Pause Menu.
````

````text
540:      - *Solution*: `World::updateProcedural` now dynamically computes the bounding box of all active tiles $[\min(x_i), \max(x_i)]$, clamping `leftGenEdge = minTileX` and `rightGenEdge = maxTileX`. Running leftward immediately triggers new chunk instantiation.
541:    - **Zero Mid-Air Floating on Scene Return**:
542:      - *Ground Raycast Snapping*: When returning from `SCENE_LADDER_CLIMB` or `SCENE_SKY_FALL`, the engine calls `World::ensureGroundAround(p_x)` to guarantee platform existence across $[p_x - 45, p_x + 45]$. It then conducts a vertical scan over all active tiles directly underneath the player's horizontal coordinate $p_x$:
543:        $$y_{\text{ground}} = \max \{ t_y + 0.5 \cdot t_h \mid |t_x - p_x| \le 0.5 \cdot t_w + 0.4 \}$$
544:      - If solid ground is detected within $4.0\,\text{m}$ below the player, the player's feet are snapped flush ($p_y = y_{\text{ground}} + 0.5 \cdot h$) and `isGrounded = true`. If returning over an intentional gap/chasm, `isGrounded = false` is preserved and normal downward gravity accelerates the character, eliminating mid-air freezing.
545:    - **Direction Arrowheads vs. Shield Fruits**:
546:      - *Direction Arrowhead Relics*: Custom 4-frame sprite sheet (`assets/direction_arrows.png`, $256 \times 64$) provides unambiguous visual cues (Left, Right, Up, Down). `Common.h` provides `getDirectionArrowUV(RunDirection dir)` mapping normalized UV coordinates $[\frac{i}{4}, \frac{i+1}{4}]$. Relics trigger the exact direction indicated by their arrowhead.
547:      - *Fruit Energy Shield*: Separated fruit pickups from direction warps. Picking up a fruit activates `shieldTimer = 10.0f`. While active, a pulsating cyan energy bubble renders around the warrior, and spike hazards, flying raptor birds, and sky mines are harmlessly deflected without damage.
548:    - **Idle Stance at Launch**:
549:      - On game initialization and reset, `isGameIdleAtStart = true`, zeroing initial velocity $\mathbf{v} = (0, 0)$ and locking animation to `ANIM_IDLE`. Pressing `A`, `D`, or `Space` dismisses the idle state and initiates active traversal.
550:    - **Sky-Fall Mini-Game Hazard Density Retuning**:
551:      - Increased obstacle spacing along the descent vector from $5.0\,\text{m}$ to $14.0\,\text{m}$.
552:      - Reduced bird flock spawn probability to $50\%$ with calibrated horizontal flight speeds ($3.0 - 4.5\,\text{m/s}$).
553:      - Reduced spike mine density to $33\%$ and tightened collision AABB bounding radii to $0.85\,\text{m}$ for crisp, skill-based dodging.
554: 
555: 9. **Mini-Game Scene Direction Relics & Safe Runner Return (`v0.5.7` & `v0.5.8`)**:
556:    - **Post-15s Immediate Relic Injection (Ladders & Sky-Fall)**:
557:      - As soon as the 15-second survival trial expires (`scenePlayTime >= SCENE_DIRECTION_COOLDOWN`):
558:        - **In 3-Ladder Ascent (`UP`)**: The engine immediately injects glowing directional arrow relics directly ahead of the climber on Lane 0 (`DIR_LEFT`), Lane 2 (`DIR_RIGHT`), and Lane 1 (`DIR_LEFT`).
559:        - **In Sky-Fall Diving (`DOWN`)**: The engine retroactively converts all uncollected items ahead of the falling character into Left and Right direction relics, and spawns three staggered multi-lane gates in the descent route ($y - 5\,\text{m}$, $y - 10\,\text{m}$, $y - 15\,\text{m}$).
560:      - This ensures the player is never trapped without an immediate, visible exit trigger after surviving the trial.
561:    - **Procedural Relic Streaming**:
562:      - Once $t \ge 15.0\,\text{s}$, runtime generation guarantees Left (Cyan) and Right (Gold) arrow relics in every descent tier of Sky-Fall and with 40% probability on ladder tracks.
563:    - **Expanded Aerial Collision Volume & Scaling**:
564:      - Aerial relics in Sky-Fall feature an enlarged collision volume ($1.85\,\text{m} \times 2.1\,\text{m}$) and scaled sprite footprint ($1.65\,\text{m}$ with a $1.65 + 0.20\sin(5t)$ pulse) so players diving at $9.2\,\text{m/s}$ easily touch the relic when steering sideways.
565:    - **Touch & Warp Scene Return**:
566:      - Touching a direction arrow relic plays `SFX_RELIC`, sets `platformerSavedDir`, `lastHorizontalDir`, and `currentDirection` to that direction, displays floating text (`"DIRECTION TRIGGERED!\nWARP <<< LEFT"` or `"WARP >>> RIGHT"`), and invokes `returnToPlatformerScene(true)`. The warrior immediately resumes running horizontally across the platformer world with ground snapping.
567: 
568: 10. **In-Engine Video Playback & Asset Embedding Analysis (`v0.5.9`)**:
569:     - **In-Engine Video Architecture (`VideoPlayer`)**:
570:       - Uses native **Windows Media Foundation** (`IMFSourceReader`, `-lmfplat -lmfreadwrite -lmfuuid -lole32`), eliminating external library dependencies or third-party DLLs.
571:       - Decodes compressed H.264 video streams directly to 32-bit RGB/BGRA pixel frames on CPU and uploads them to an OpenGL 2D texture via `glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0, width, height, GL_BGRA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, pData)`.
572:       - Concurrently decodes AAC audio into in-memory uncompressed PCM Wave format (`WAVEFORMATEX`), streaming synchronously with video timestamps via asynchronous `PlaySoundA`.
573:       - Features dynamic letterboxing preserving 16:9 aspect ratios across any resolution, an animated bottom progress bar, and user-friendly skip handling via `Space`, `Esc`, or `Enter`.
574:     - **Asset Embedding Feasibility & Size Reduction Analysis**:
575:       - *Is it possible to embed `assets/introVid.mp4` into game files?*
576:         **Yes.** It can be embedded either as a compiled Windows Resource (`.rc` script compiled via `windres` into a `.res`/`.o` object linked into `main.exe`) or converted into a C++ `const uint8_t introVideoBytes[]` array.
577:       - *Will embedding reduce file size?*
578:         **No.** MP4 files encoded with H.264/AAC are already compressed using modern lossy discrete cosine transform (DCT) and Huffman/CABAC entropy coding. Embedding an MP4 file into an executable simply appends its raw byte stream into the PE `.rsrc` or `.rodata` sections. The overall storage footprint remains equal or slightly larger. Real size reduction can only be achieved via video transcoding (e.g., downscaling from 1080p to 720p or reducing bitrate from ~2500 kbps to ~900 kbps, which reduces file size by ~70%).
````

````text
97: ### 3.2 Hybrid Audio Engine (`/src/Audio.cpp` & `/include/Audio.h`)
98: Combines zero-dependency procedural synthesis with hardware-accelerated media streaming:
99: - **In-Memory Procedural PCM Synthesis**:
100:   - Dynamically builds 44-byte RIFF/WAVE headers followed by 16-bit mono PCM samples at $22,050\,\text{Hz}$ directly in RAM.
101:   - Dispatches non-blocking playback via `PlaySoundA` (`SND_MEMORY | SND_ASYNC`), eliminating missing asset errors:
102:     1. `SFX_SLASH`: Aerodynamic whoosh ($2400 \rightarrow 320\,\text{Hz}$) with steel ring harmonics ($3250\,\text{Hz}, 4950\,\text{Hz}$).
103:     2. `SFX_BLOCK`: Sharp metallic parry clink plus dual resonant ringing bells ($2850\,\text{Hz}, 4150\,\text{Hz}$) with $280\,\text{ms}$ decay.
104:     3. `SFX_ENEMY_HIT`, `SFX_ENEMY_ATTACK`, `SFX_ENEMY_DEATH`: Impact crunches and creature combat feedback.
105:     4. `SFX_HEART_PICKUP`: Dual-tone melodic restoration chime ($587\,\text{Hz} \rightarrow 880\,\text{Hz}$).
106:     5. `SFX_STEP`, `SFX_JUMP`, `SFX_CLIMB`, `SFX_SLIDE`, `SFX_COIN`, `SFX_RELIC`, `SFX_SHIFT`, `SFX_DEATH`.
107: - **Windows MCI Hardware-Accelerated Streaming**:
108:   - Streams looping background music [`assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`](/assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3) using `mciSendStringA` at 50% default volume.
109:   - Features real-time `[M]` key mute/unmute toggle with HUD badges and floating text notifications.
110:   - Handles the 3-phase sequenced Demon Slime transformation audio ($5.5\text{s}$: wet splat $\rightarrow$ bubbling acid $\rightarrow$ monster roar), thunder spell strikes, and the Boss Demon Slime dying roar vocalization [`assets/dyingRoar.mp3`](/assets/dyingRoar.mp3).

114: ### 3.3 Graphics Pipeline & Shader Architecture (`/src/Renderer.cpp` & `/include/Renderer.h`)
115: Implements Modern OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile graphics:
116: - **GLSL Shaders**:
117:   - **Vertex Shader**: Multiplies quad vertices by $P \times V \times M$. Applies dynamic UV sub-rect transformations via uniform `uUVRect = (u, v, du, dv)`:
118:     $$\text{TexCoord} = (u + aTexCoord.x \cdot du, \; v + aTexCoord.y \cdot dv)$$
119:   - **Fragment Shader**: Samples colors from `sampler2D uTexture` and applies alpha discard threshold (`if (texColor.a < 0.1) discard;`) multiplied by tint `uColor`.
120: - **Circular Energy Shield Discard Math**:
121:   - Renders a protective circular shield bubble by evaluating normalized quad distance in the fragment shader:
122:     $$r = \sqrt{(x - 0.5)^2 + (y - 0.5)^2}$$
123:     Pixels with $r > 0.5$ are discarded, creating a perfect glowing circular energy bubble without tessellating curved 3D geometry.
124: - **Single Reusable Quad VAO/VBO**:
125:   - A single $1 \times 1$ unit square (2 triangles, 6 vertices) is permanently resident in GPU VRAM. Every entity, tile, character sprite, and HUD element is rendered using this quad scaled, translated, and rotated by the Model Matrix ($M$).
````

````text
331: ### Q3: Why does the game use both Procedural Audio and Windows MCI Streaming?
332: > **Answer**:  
333: > We use a **Hybrid Audio Architecture**:
334: > 1. **Procedural Synthesis (WinMM)** generates instantaneous arcade sound effects (sword slashes, parry clangs, jumps, coin chimes) directly in RAM via math formulas, guaranteeing zero missing asset crashes.
335: > 2. **Windows MCI Streaming** handles long-form background music (`Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`) with real-time volume/mute controls and complex creature vocalizations without consuming massive amounts of RAM.
336: 
337: ### Q4: How does the game ensure the player can dodge telegraphed boss and spell attacks?
338: > **Answer**:  
339: > Through **Telegraphed Wind-Up Windows**:
340: > - The Demon Slime has a $1.125\text{s}$ wind-up animation with an overhead alert (`"[ ! ] DODGE!"`) before damage is dealt.
341: > - The Bringer of Death has a $0.75\text{s}$ melee wind-up and a $1.0\text{s}$ spell gathering phase.
342: > - Crucially, enemy facing direction is **locked** during the telegraph. If the player jumps or dashes behind the enemy during the windup, the attack misses completely.
343: 
344: ### Q5: How is the Katana Defend / Block mechanic implemented?
345: > **Answer**:  
346: > Right Click (or `K`) triggers `isBlocking = true` for up to $1.0\text{s}$ using `Defend_nobg.png`. In the collision detection loops, if `isBlocking` is true when an enemy attack connects, player damage is bypassed, a metallic parry SFX (`SFX_BLOCK`) plays, floating `"[PARRY]"` text appears, and a $2.0\text{s}$ cooldown is applied to prevent parry spamming.
347: 
348: ### Q6: How does the game manage endless world generation without running out of RAM?
349: > **Answer**:  
350: > Through **Procedural Generation and Dynamic Chunk Pruning** in [`/src/World.cpp`](/src/World.cpp#L635-L665). The engine generates level chunks $35\,\text{m}$ ahead in both directions ($+X$ and $-X$). As the player moves, any chunks farther than $85\,\text{m}$ behind are pruned from memory arrays. This bounds active memory to a constant footprint.
351: 
352: ### Q7: How does the game render the Academic Intro Splash Screen without external image files?
353: > **Answer**:  
354: > Through **Procedural Modern OpenGL Vector & Font Rendering** in [`/src/UIManager.cpp#L68-L230`](/src/UIManager.cpp#L68-L230):
355: > 1. The presentation card, borders, title underlines, and table lines for instructors and group members are rendered as scaled unit quads using matrix math (`glm::scale` and `glm::translate`).
356: > 2. Typography is rendered directly from an embedded 8x8 bitmap font ([`/include/font8x8_basic.h`](/include/font8x8_basic.h)), eliminating external image dependencies.
357: > 3. Fade transitions are calculated via piece-wise linear alpha interpolation ($\alpha(t) = \frac{t}{T_{\text{in}}}$), modulating quad colors cleanly before launching the intro video.
358: 
359: ### Q8: How do the Direction Arrow Relics control the multi-directional mechanics?
360: > **Answer**:  
361: > Direction relics ([`DirectionRelic`](/include/Common.h#L159)) store target vectors (`DIR_LEFT`, `DIR_RIGHT`, `DIR_UP`, `DIR_DOWN`) and floating animation phases. When the player intersects their $1.1\times 1.1\,\text{m}$ hitbox ([`/src/main.cpp#L1230-L1246`](/src/main.cpp#L1230-L1246)):
362: > 1. Horizontal relics (`DIR_LEFT`/`DIR_RIGHT`) invert running velocity, swap player facing direction, and switch biome themes.
363: > 2. Vertical relics (`DIR_UP`/`DIR_DOWN`) trigger transitions into dedicated mini-game scenes ([`LadderScene`](/src/LadderScene.cpp) or [`SkyFallScene`](/src/SkyFallScene.cpp)).
364: > 3. Inside mini-games, Left/Right arrow relics spawn after a 15-second survival cooldown to serve as return exit gates back to the platformer world.
````

````text
Implemented all three requested features and synchronized the project documentation and session archives:

### 1. Regular-Run Relics & Open Exit Gate Mini-Game Icons
- **Removed Left/Right Relics from Regular Run**: Updated [`World::generateChunk`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/World.cpp#L329-L335) (initial and procedural platforms) to roll only `{ DIR_UP, DIR_DOWN }` instead of `{ DIR_LEFT, DIR_RIGHT, DIR_UP, DIR_DOWN }`.
- **Open Exit Gate Asset**: Generated a 4-frame animated $256 \times 64$ glowing open gate spritesheet at [assets/exit_gate.png](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/assets/exit_gate.png) (and [TheWenderer/assets/exit_gate.png](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/TheWenderer/assets/exit_gate.png)) via [gen_exit_gate.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/scratch/gen_exit_gate.cpp), paired with [`getExitGateUV`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/include/Common.h#L334-L341).
- **Mini-Game Exit Gates**: Updated [`LadderScene`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/LadderScene.cpp#L70-L78), [`SkyFallScene`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/SkyFallScene.cpp#L86-L108), [`UIManager::renderTrialBadge`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/UIManager.cpp#L387), and [main.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/main.cpp#L2036-L2047) so post-15s exits spawn and render animated Open Exit Gates instead of Left/Right arrows.

### 2. Dynamic 3-Phase Enemy Spawning & Phase 3 Horde Spawn
- **2-Minute Phase Progression**: Added `ENEMY_PHASE_DURATION = 120.0f` and `HORDE_SPAWN_COOLDOWN = 180.0f` in [Common.h](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/include/Common.h#L102-L105) and implemented [`World::updateEnemySpawning`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/World.cpp#L676-L735):
  - **Phase 1 (0–2 min)**: Rare spawns in [`World::generateChunk`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/World.cpp#L635-L654) and 20s periodic checks, strictly capped at **2 active enemies** at once.
  - **Phase 2 (2–4 min)**: Increased chunk (1–2 per enemy type) and 10s periodic spawns, capped at 6 active enemies.
  - **Phase 3 (4+ min)**: Peak chunk (1–3 Bringer of Death, 2–4 Slimes) and 6s periodic spawns (cap 12), plus [`World::spawnHordeWave`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/World.cpp#L656-L674) which randomly spawns **3 Slimes** and **3 Bringers of Death** around the player on a **3-minute (`180.0f`s) cooldown** with roar SFX and HUD alerts in [main.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/main.cpp#L838-L865).

### 3. Music Volume Control Slider (10% Increments, Default 30%)
- **Audio Manager**: Updated [`AudioManager`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/include/Audio.h#L27-L44) and [Audio.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/Audio.cpp#L59-L97) so looping BGM defaults to **30%** (`bgmVolumePercent = 30`, MCI volume `300`), with `setBgmVolumePercent` and `adjustBgmVolume` snapping to 10% increments (`0%`–`100%`).
- **Interactive Slider UI & Controls**: Added [`UIManager::getPauseVolumeSliderLayout`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/UIManager.cpp#L403-L413) and updated [`UIManager::renderPauseMenu`](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/UIManager.cpp#L415-L580) to draw a 10%-notched slider with `[-]`/`[+]` buttons and draggable knob. Wired mouse click/drag, `Left`/`Right` (`A`/`D`) in the Pause Menu, `-`/`=` quick steps, and `[M]` mute toggle in [main.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/src/main.cpp#L2771-L2870).

### Verification & Documentation
- **Unit Logic Verification**: Compiled and ran [verify_logic.cpp](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/scratch/verify_logic.cpp) (`ALL VERIFICATION ASSERTIONS PASSED!`, verifying 30% default & 10% volume steps, zero Left/Right relics across 25 chunks, 2-minute phase transitions, Phase 1 max-2 cap, and Phase 3 Horde Spawns of `slimes=3, bods=3` with 180s cooldown).
- **Full Build**: Compiled and linked all 9 translation units cleanly (`exit code 0`) to `build/main_new.exe` and updated [TheWenderer.exe](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/TheWenderer/TheWenderer.exe). Note: `build/main.exe` could not be overwritten because it is currently locked by a running process; close it and rename `build/main_new.exe` to `build/main.exe` (or run `make`) to update `build/main.exe`.
- **Documentation & Archives**: Updated [README.md](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/README.md), [changelog.md](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/doc/changelog.md) (`v0.8.0`), [LEARNING_GUIDE.md](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/doc/LEARNING_GUIDE.md), [documentation.md](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/doc/documentation.md), [explain.md](file:///d:/GitHub/UITS/CGMLabProject_2DGame/doc/explain.md), and synced the Session 9 archive under `doc/prompts/9. ### Thinking
````
````markdown
I'm thinking through how to approach this.


Calculating framebuffer size and window attributes. Considering cases for fullscreen or maximized windows, adjusting viewport dimensions based on aspect ratio and ensuring horizontal field of view doesn't shrink below the default aspect. Adjusting the viewport height to maintain the base aspect ratio.


The initial viewport is cleared to black, creating the undesired vertical borders when the game window doesn't match the framebuffer's aspect ratio. The viewport is then adjusted to the correct game dimensions using `glViewport` and `glScissor`, but the initial clear operation on the full framebuffer causes the black borders. The solution involves clearing the viewport region directly to match the desired background color instead of a full framebuffer clear.


Now clears the active gameplay area using the viewport dimensions to match background color; calculates an orthographic projection matrix using the viewport's half-width and half-height, ensuring pixels-per-meter are consistent and the horizontal view expands correctly with window width. Adds F11 key binding for borderless/monitor fullscreen toggling using `glfwSetWindowMonitor`, saving windowed position and dimensions; retrieves cursor position and window size for pause menu mouse hit-testing.


Now maps cursor clicks within the letterboxed viewport to the UI coordinate system using normalized coordinates and viewport dimensions, ensuring correct UI interaction regardless of window state. Adjusted star positions by expanding the X range, increasing the total number of stars to cover the full screen in wider fullscreen views. Updated UI manager to tighten menu height.
````

````text
1: # Agent Guidelines & Workflow Rules
2: 
3: These instructions define the mandatory operational protocols, archiving procedures, and documentation standards for AI agents working in this repository.
4: 
5: ---
6: 
7: ## 1. Chat & Conversation Archiving Protocol
8: 
9: ### Target Archive Directory & Serial Session Folders
10: - All session archives reside inside [`doc/prompts/`](/doc/prompts/) in dedicated serial folders named with an incrementing major integer prefix:
11:   `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` (e.g., `doc/prompts/6. Boss Battle Polish/`).
12: - **Determining `<N>`:** Inspect `doc/prompts/` to find the highest existing major integer prefix across existing session folders (`<N>. .../`), legacy `vX.Y` files (e.g. `v5.0` -> `5`), and legacy flat files, and assign `N = N_max + 1` for a brand-new conversation session.
13: - **Session Continuity:** Always update **the same session folder** (`doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`) on each turn or when resuming an existing conversation; do NOT create a new major folder per turn.
14: 
15: ### Required Files Inside `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/`
16: 1. **`transcript_full.jsonl`**
17:    - An exact, unmodified UTF-8 copy of `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`.
18:    - Never truncate, edit, or reformat lines in `transcript_full.jsonl`.
19: 2. **`conversation.md`**
20:    - A verbatim Markdown rendering generated directly from `transcript_full.jsonl`, including **every step exactly** without summarizing, paraphrasing, or omitting content:
21:      - Conversation metadata (`Conversation ID`, `Session Folder`, and `Continued From` if applicable).
22:      - All user messages (`USER_INPUT.content`).
23:      - All agent thoughts / thinking (`PLANNER_RESPONSE.thinking`) verbatim.
24:      - All tool calls (`PLANNER_RESPONSE.tool_calls`) and tool/system outputs (`GENERIC` / `SYSTEM_MESSAGE`).
25:      - All agent responses (`PLANNER_RESPONSE.content`) verbatim.
26: 3. **`summary.md` (Conversation Summary Markdown)**
27:    - Maintained alongside `transcript_full.jsonl` and `conversation.md` in the same folder.
28:    - Summarizes session metadata (`Conversation ID`, date, context), user goals, engineering/physics analysis, files created/modified (using root-relative links such as `[/README.md](/README.md)`), verification steps, and outcomes.
29: 4. **Companion Plans & Walkthroughs (Fractional Suffixes)**
30:    - Stored inside the same `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/` folder:
31:      - Implementation plan: `<N>.1 Implementation Plan - <Plan Title>.md`
32:      - Walkthrough document: `<N>.2 Walkthrough - <Title>.md`
33:      - Subsequent plans/walkthroughs in the same session: `<N>.3 ...`, `<N>.4 ...`, etc.
34: 
35: ---
36: 
37: ## 2. Update Cadence (Keeping the Archive Current)
38: 
39: Because the runtime writes a turn's final `PLANNER_RESPONSE` (including its final `thinking` and `content`) to `transcript_full.jsonl` after the turn finishes:
40: 
41: 1. **At the start of each turn (or when continuing from a prior `<conversation-id>`):**
42:    - Copy `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl` to `doc/prompts/<N>. <Session Title>/transcript_full.jsonl` and regenerate `conversation.md` so the previous turn's finalized `thinking` and `content` are captured verbatim.
43:    - If continuing from a prior conversation ID, ensure its archive folder is also synced and finalized.
44: 2. **Before sending each new final response:**
45:    - Re-copy `transcript_full.jsonl` and regenerate `conversation.md` to capture all completed steps of the current turn (new user prompt, tool calls, intermediate `thinking`, and tool/system outputs).
46:    - Append the exact final response text being sent under `## Pending Final Response (Pre-Commit)` at the bottom of `conversation.md` (with a note that it will be replaced verbatim by the runtime-committed `thinking` + `content` from `transcript_full.jsonl` on the next sync).
47:    - Create or update `summary.md` in the same folder with the latest session summary.
48: 
49: 
50: ---
51: 
52: ## 3. Documentation & Changelog Update Protocol
53: 
54: Whenever changes, features, refactoring, or phase milestones are implemented:
55: 
56: 1. **Update Relevant Documentation in [`doc/`](/doc/)**:
57:    - Keep [`doc/LEARNING_GUIDE.md`](/doc/LEARNING_GUIDE.md) synchronized with any architectural changes, new shader uniforms, controls, or data structures.
58:    - Explain all concepts in simple, accessible language for learning purposes.
59: 
60: 2. **Update [`README.md`](/README.md)**:
````

````text
1: # Session Archive: Combat System, 3 Lives, Spikes, Bringer of Death, and Demon Slime Boss Battle
2: 
3: - **Session Version**: v5.0
4: - **Date**: 2026-10-25
5: - **Context**: Implementation of player melee combat (J/X/LMB), 3-lives health system, ruby heart pickups, procedural metallic spike hazards, Bringer of Death roaming enemy, Demon Slime Boss Battle encounter with delayed metamorphosis, avoidance/despawn mechanics, overhead segmented health bars, and 8 procedural synthesized SFX waveforms.
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ### User Input
10: ```text
11: 1. make th shield relics spawn less frequent, and away from direction cahnge relics.
12: 2. Make the traps look like spikes and not pumpkins. Add moving enemy https://clembod.itch.io/bringer-of-death-free that attack when getting close. 
13: 3. Add a boss battle scene that can be manually engaged by going near https://chierit.itch.io/boss-demon-slime . Fighting the initial slime  (that spawn at random) and defeating it will spawn the bigger boss (with a delay in transformation) and it can be avoided by going to the opposite direction or dashing through it, so it despawns. The boss will deal damage to the player if they go near it directly or by doing attack animations. 
14: 4. Introduce 3 lives for the players that can absorb 3 hits and can be restored by picking up heart shapred relics (add them beside the shield relic). 
15: 5. Introduce Attack animation for the player so it can defeat the roaming enemies in 1 hit, slimes in 2 hits and the boss (transformed from slime) in 5 hits. Show health bar over the enemies calculated with that logic. 
16: 6. Add sfx for the enemies.
17: ```
18: 
19: ---
20: 
21: ### AI Technical Analysis & Implementation Strategy
22: 
23: #### 1. Requirement & Constraint Analysis
24: - **Hazard Visual Fidelity & Misattribution (Spikes vs. Pumpkins)**:
25:   - Inspection of the Brackeys `world_tileset.png` at tile coordinate $(4, 8)$ revealed an orange autumnal pumpkin ($RGB(149, 98, 24)$) rather than a metallic spike trap. This visual mismatch caused player confusion regarding lethal hazards.
26:   - *Engineering Strategy*: Procedurally synthesized a dedicated high-resolution $64\times 64$ metallic spike trap texture `assets/spikes.png` displaying three razor-sharp steel spikes with ambient occlusion, metallic specular highlights, and a hazard-red base bar. Configured UV mapping across the platform runner, `LadderScene`, and `SkyFallScene` to render genuine steel spikes.
27: - **Relic Deconfliction & Spacing Architecture**:
28:   - Previously, Mystery Fruit Relics (granting 10s shields) were placed in close proximity to directional arrowheads, causing accidental shield pickups or involuntary direction shifts when attempting to grab protective shields.
29:   - *Engineering Strategy*: Segregated shield pickups to elevated, isolated sky canopy platforms, reducing procedural spawn probability to a calibrated 1-in-5 chance (`!hasDirectionRelic && rand() % 5 == 0`), placing heart pickups directly adjacent to shield pickups for clear defensive utility clustering.
30: - **Player 3-Lives Pipeline & Grace Recovery Invulnerability**:
31:   - The previous physics loop immediately triggered `STATE_GAME_OVER` upon touching any unshielded hazard.
32:   - *Engineering Strategy*: Introduced `playerLives = 3` with visual heart pip rendering in the top-right Score HUD. Taking damage from spike impalement, enemy blade swings, or slime contact decrements 1 life pip and immediately engages a $1.25\text{s}$ grace period (`postHitInvulnTimer = 1.25f`) with red damage screen tinting and floating text feedback (`"LIFE LOST! (X/3)"`). Death occurs strictly when `playerLives <= 0`.
33:   - Created animated 4-frame ruby heart pickups (`assets/heart_pickup.png`). Picking up a heart restores $+1$ life pip up to the maximum of 3, or confers $+150$ bonus score if already at maximum health.
34: - **Real-Time Combat & Hitbox Arc Sweeping**:
35:   - Enabled sword attack triggers via **`[J]`**, **`[X]`**, and **Left Mouse Click (LMB)**.
36:   - Decoupled full animation length ($6\text{ frames} \approx 0.5\text{s}$) from the active swing contact window ($t \in [0.10, 0.32]\text{s}$). During active swing frames, projected an oriented forward hitbox arc:
37:     $$\mathbf{p}_{\text{hit}} = \mathbf{p}_{\text{player}} + (\text{dirSign} \times 1.35\,\hat{\mathbf{i}})$$
38:   - Integrated `attackDamageDealt` latch to ensure a single swing damages enemies exactly once per attack cycle.
39: - **Enemy Archetypes & Finite State Machine (FSM)**:
40:   - Downloaded official itch asset packages for [Bringer of Death](https://clembod.itch.io/bringer-of-death-free) and [Boss Demon Slime](https://chierit.itch.io/boss-demon-slime). Converted and assembled horizontal sprite strips in `assets/enemies/`.
41:   - **Bringer of Death (1 Hit)**: Roams platforms in `ENEMY_STATE_PATROL`. Detects player within $12\text{m}$, transitions to alert chase, and executes scythe cleave in `ENEMY_STATE_ATTACK` within $2.0\text{m}$. Slain in 1 hit (+250 pts).
42:   - **Initial Slime (2 Hits)**: Spawns randomly along ground platforms. Hops towards player; slain in 2 hits.
43:   - **Transformation Metamorphosis**: Defeating the initial slime triggers `ENEMY_STATE_TRANSFORM` (3.2-second transformation delay, playing 32-frame slime metamorphosis animation and synthesized demonic roars).
44:   - **Boss Demon Slime (5 Hits)**: Giant $8.5\times 8.5\text{m}$ boss entity. Deals contact proximity damage ($<2.5\text{m}$) and heavy cleave damage ($4.8\text{m}$). Slain in 5 hits (+1000 pts).
45:   - **Boss Avoidance & Spatial Despawning**: If player runs in the opposite direction ($>28\text{m}$) or executes a Shadow Dash through the boss ($>8\text{m}$ clear), the boss retreats and despawns cleanly without game-over penalty.
46: - **Overhead Segmented Health Bars**:
47:   - Dynamically rendered floating world-space health bars over active enemies via `UIManager::renderEnemyHealthBars`. Calculated integer division tick marks displaying remaining hits (1 for BOD, 2 for Slime, 5 for Boss) with thematic color codings (Violet for BOD, Emerald for Slime, Crimson for Boss Demon).
48: - **Procedural Audio Synthesis**:
49:   - Generated 8 synthetic procedural waveforms directly in `Audio.cpp`: `SFX_SLASH`, `SFX_ENEMY_HIT`, `SFX_ENEMY_ATTACK`, `SFX_ENEMY_DEATH`, `SFX_SLIME_BOUNCE`, `SFX_BOSS_ROAR`, `SFX_BOSS_ATTACK`, `SFX_HEART_PICKUP`.
50: 
51: ---
52: 
53: ### Actions & Tools Executed
54: - **Asset Acquisition & Processing**:
55:   - Implemented automated itch token downloader (`build/fetch_assets.py`) to fetch official packages for Bringer of Death and Boss Demon Slime.
56:   - Extracted slime animation frames (`slime_idle.gif`, `slime_move.gif`, `slime_take_hit.gif`, `slime_transform.gif`) using standard Python libraries into `assets/enemies/`.
57:   - Procedurally generated metallic spike hazard texture `assets/spikes.png` ($64\times 64$) and ruby heart texture `assets/heart_pickup.png` ($256\times 64$) via `build/generate_spikes_and_heart.py`.
58:   - Assembled horizontal spritesheets for all Bringer of Death and Boss Demon Slime animations via `build/assemble_enemy_sprites.py`.
59: - **Code Modifications**:
60:   - [`include/Common.h`](/include/Common.h): Defined `SFXType` additions, `EnemyType`, `EnemyState`, `EnemyEntity`, `HeartPickup`, and UV mapping helpers.
61:   - [`include/World.h`](/include/World.h) & [`src/World.cpp`](/src/World.cpp): Separated shield and direction relics, added procedural heart and enemy spawning, updated distance pruning and reset logic.
62:   - [`src/Audio.cpp`](/src/Audio.cpp): Synthesized 8 procedural audio waveforms for combat, roars, hits, and pickups.
63:   - [`include/UIManager.h`](/include/UIManager.h) & [`src/UIManager.cpp`](/src/UIManager.cpp): Added 3 heart pips to `renderScoreHUD`, implemented `renderEnemyHealthBars`, updated tutorial modal and controls documentation.
64:   - [`include/LadderScene.h`](/include/LadderScene.h), [`src/LadderScene.cpp`](/src/LadderScene.cpp), [`include/SkyFallScene.h`](/include/SkyFallScene.h), [`src/SkyFallScene.cpp`](/src/SkyFallScene.cpp): Integrated `spikesTexture` in render pipelines.
65:   - [`src/main.cpp`](/src/main.cpp): Implemented attack keybindings (`J`/`X`/`LMB`), 3 lives damage handling, heart collection, enemy AI update loop, boss transformation/despawn, and quad rendering.
66: - **Compilation & Verification**:
67:   - Compiled project cleanly using MinGW `g++.exe` with C++17 into `./build/main.exe`.
68:   - Packaged standalone distribution in [`TheWenderer/`](/TheWenderer/) and updated [`TheWenderer_Standalone.zip`](/TheWenderer_Standalone.zip).
69:   - Synchronized documentation in [`README.md`](/README.md), [`doc/CHANGELOG.md`](/doc/CHANGELOG.md), and [`doc/LEARNING_GUIDE.md`](/doc/LEARNING_GUIDE.md).

76: 2. **Hazard Spikes & Bringer of Death Enemy**: Procedural steel spike hazard texture replacing pumpkins; Bringer of Death roaming enemy with scythe attack.
````

````text
1: # Session Archive: Academic Intro Splash Screen with Course and Group Details and Fade Transition
2: 
3: - **Session Version**: v7.0
4: - **Date**: 2026-11-02
5: - **Context**: Implementation of an academic introductory splash screen displaying course details, faculty information, and student group details prior to the intro video, completed with a smooth fade in-out transition, bilinear filtering, and procedural fallback UI.
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ### User Input
10: ```text
11: I want to add a intro splash screen that will show the course details, faculty details, and group details. This will run before the intro video with a fade in-out transition.
12: ```
13: *(User attached project proposal title document image: `media_1793627403679_8d8b7c15.png`)*
14: 
15: ### AI Technical Analysis & Implementation Strategy
16: > **1. Requirement Decomposition & Architectural Sequencing**:
17: > - The game engine previously launched immediately into `STATE_INTRO_VIDEO`, rendering an MP4 video stream using Windows Media Foundation (`IMFSourceReader`) with asynchronous sound playback (`PlaySoundA`).
18: > - The requirement dictates inserting an academic introductory splash screen displaying official project submission metadata (Course: *Computer Graphics & Multimedia Lab - CSE0611328*, Faculty: *Engineer Robiul Islam - Assistant Professor* & *Tasneen Tanvir - Lecturer*, Group Members: *Gaus Saraf Murady 0432410005101088*, *Lima Akter 0432410005101063*, *Fahima Akter 0432410005101093*, *Semester Autumn 2026, Batch 55, Dept CSE*) before the video begins.
19: > - An audio lifecycle race condition was diagnosed: `introVideoPlayer.open()` immediately starts decoding audio and calls `PlaySoundA`. If the video player was initialized at program start, video audio would overlap the splash screen. To guarantee audio-visual isolation, video initialization is decoupled and deferred to `startIntroVideo()`, invoked only when the splash sequence concludes.
20: >
21: > **2. State Machine Pipeline**:
22: > - Updated `enum GameState` in `[/include/Common.h](/include/Common.h)` to place `STATE_INTRO_SPLASH = 0` as the initial game state, followed sequentially by `STATE_INTRO_VIDEO = 1`, `STATE_RUNNING = 2`, `STATE_PAUSED = 3`, and `STATE_GAME_OVER = 4`.
23: > - Initialized the engine in `STATE_INTRO_SPLASH`, configuring dedicated timers: total duration $T_{\text{total}} = 5.5\,\text{s}$, fade-in duration $T_{\text{in}} = 1.0\,\text{s}$, hold duration $T_{\text{hold}} = 3.5\,\text{s}$, and fade-out duration $T_{\text{out}} = 1.0\,\text{s}$.
24: >
25: > **3. Mathematical Model for Fade In-Out Alpha Blending**:
26: > - The opacity multiplier $\alpha(t) \in [0.0, 1.0]$ is computed using piecewise linear interpolation:
27: >   $$\alpha(t) = \begin{cases} \frac{t}{T_{\text{in}}} & 0 \le t < T_{\text{in}} \\ 1.0 & T_{\text{in}} \le t \le T_{\text{total}} - T_{\text{out}} \\ \frac{T_{\text{total}} - t}{T_{\text{out}}} & T_{\text{total}} - T_{\text{out}} < t \le T_{\text{total}} \end{cases}$$
28: > - In OpenGL fragment execution, the texture color is modulated by uniform color $u_{\text{color}} = (1, 1, 1, \alpha)$:
29: >   $$\text{FragColor} = \text{Texture}(\text{TexCoord}) \times u_{\text{color}}$$
30: > - With `glEnable(GL_BLEND)` and `glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA)`, this yields a gradual fade from pure cinematic black, pristine presentation at full opacity, and a gentle dissolve back to black before video initialization.
31: >
32: > **4. Dual Filtering Pipeline (`GL_LINEAR` vs `GL_NEAREST`)**:
33: > - Sprite sheets (e.g., pixel-art samurai, slimes, and tilesets) require nearest-neighbor sampling (`GL_NEAREST`) to prevent pixel blurring.
34: > - High-density text and document graphics (such as `assets/splash.png` at $762 \times 769\,\text{px}$) become heavily aliased and jagged under nearest-neighbor filtering.
35: > - Extended `Renderer::loadTexture(const char* filepath, bool linear = false)` in `[/include/Renderer.h](/include/Renderer.h)` and `[/src/Renderer.cpp](/src/Renderer.cpp)` to parameterize the minification and magnification filters (`GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER` / `GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER`). When `linear = true`, OpenGL enables hardware bilinear interpolation, producing crisp, smooth document typography.
36: >
37: > **5. Visual Staging & Procedural Fallback UI**:
38: > - Implemented `UIManager::renderSplashScreen` in `[/src/UIManager.cpp](/src/UIManager.cpp)`:
39: >   - **Cinematic Studio Backdrop**: Fullscreen quad in deep charcoal slate (`glm::vec4(0.03f, 0.04f, 0.06f, 1.0f)`).
40: >   - **Document Card Framing**: Centered document quad scaled to preserve the $762:769$ aspect ratio, layered over a soft drop shadow (`glm::vec4(0, 0, 0, 0.65f * alpha)`) and a fine cyan accent border (`glm::vec4(0.25f, 0.70f, 0.95f, 0.85f * alpha)`).
41: >   - **Procedural Fallback**: If `assets/splash.png` is not found, the renderer automatically builds an in-engine vector presentation card using `gameRenderer.drawText` and geometric bounding quads with exact academic metadata.
42: >   - **Progress & Interactive Skip**: Displays a bottom progress bar and pulsing skip indicator `[SPACE / ESC / ENTER] SKIP`.
43: >
44: > **6. Edge-Triggered Key Debouncing & VRAM Management**:
45: > - Skipped transitions trigger `startIntroVideo()`, which deletes the OpenGL splash texture from VRAM (`glDeleteTextures`) to eliminate memory overhead.
46: > - Integrated edge-triggered key debounce flags (`splashSkipLast` and `videoSkipLast`), guaranteeing that a key held down to skip the splash screen does not bleed through to skip the intro video or game tutorial modal.
47:

50: - Modified [`/include/Common.h`](/include/Common.h) to add `STATE_INTRO_SPLASH = 0` to `enum GameState`.
````

````text
61: ### High-Level Architectural Rationale & Design Decisions
62: > 1. Analyzed the project proposal, research analysis, and implementation roadmap. The core novelty is "Wending"—sudden 90-degree orthogonal shifts in running direction paired with a smoothly rotating camera follow.
63: > 2. Replaced multi-triangle hardcoded geometry with a single reusable 1x1 Quad VAO/VBO transformed via Model-View-Projection (MVP) matrices in GLSL, significantly reducing memory and draw call overhead.
64: > 3. Modeled track segments as vector-oriented lines and bounding areas. At the end of each segment, direction indices cycle, invoking `glm::mix` to interpolate camera rotation over ~0.45 seconds.
65: > 4. Structured collision detection using Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) checks evaluated against active obstacle arrays each frame.
66: > 5. Bundled GLFW, GLAD, and GLM libraries locally to make compilation completely independent and self-contained with zero external installation friction.
````
